In addition, officials from the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, representatives from the WHO Secretariat and United Nations Agencies, development partners and representatives from non-governmental organizations will also participate in this. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to host the 78th  Session of the WHO Regional Committee Meeting for South-East Asia, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Healthy Food - Happy Life - සුවදායී දිවියකට සෞඛ්‍යවත්/සුරක්ෂිත ආහාර' -The National Media Drive
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has prioritized its direct intervention concerning food-related diseases and the lack of compliance with regard to the legal  safety guidelines associated thereto in the present day society. Accordingly, the Ministry of Health and Mass Media and Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation intends to implement the National Media Drive, 'Healthy Food - Happy Life - සුවදායී දිවියකට සෞඛ්‍යවත්/සුරක්ෂිත ආහාර' in order to launch a health promotion programme on the nutrition of Sri Lankans. This programme has been planned to implement in liaison with women, school children, public and private sector institutions associated with food safety, doctors, nutritionists, public health inspectors, farmers and cooks/chefs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said National Media Drive by the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation under the supervision of the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-commencement of the projects related to the scope of  urban development that were temporarily suspended
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The construction activities of 18 projects that were commenced in 2021 and thereafter have been temporarily suspended, slowed down or suspended by mutual consent due to problems arising amidst the economic crisis. Out of the 18 projects that were suspended, 06 projects have now been completed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to re-commence and implement the following projects that were not completed, was approved by the Cabinet: * Construction of the proposed Walapane sathi pola and the multipurpose building. * Development of the Daulagala sathi pola and the vehicle park. * Development of the Mullaitivu bus stand. * Improving sanitary facilities and landscapes in Habarana. * Development of the pathway from Ruwanweliseya vehicle park to the Jetavanaramaya. * Construction of the administrative building of Polonnaruwa new town. * Construction of the Ampara sathi pola. * Development of the Deiyandara bus stand. * Development of the Gampaha public market. * Development of the Peralanda wetland park. * Development of the Panadura public market and the multipurpose building.

description: Current status and strategic pathway in introducing the Hydrogen Economy in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is seeking sustainable solutions to reduce carbon emissions and diversify its energy mix, and green hydrogen has been identified as a viable alternative energy source which is aligned with national and global climate goals. Accordingly, the Ministry of Energy has taken several important initial steps by now, including the launch of the National Hydrogen Roadmap and drafting of a comprehensive Renewable Hydrogen Policy. The Ministry of Energy intends to conduct Public Consultation Workshops and Key Stakeholder Workshops relating to this to improve the policy framework, overcome potential problems and build a broad consensus for successful implementation of the same. Accordingly, the Cabinet took into notice of the submissions made by the Minister of Energy regarding the steps being taken to develop the Hydrogen sector in Sri Lanka in accordance with local conditions and needs and in line with international safety standards and performance benchmarks.

description: Declaration of the Sabarimala Pilgrimage as a sacred pilgrimage recognized by the Government of Sr Lanka and provision of facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - For a long time, Sri Lankan Hindu devotees have been taking part in pilgrimages to the famous Sabarimala Ayyappan Kovil in Kerala, India, every year from 1st  November to 31st  January of the following year. This has now become a spiritual pilgrimage attended by over 15,000 Sri Lankan devotees annually. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to declare the pilgrimage by Sri Lankan Hindu devotees to the Sabarimala Ayyappan Kovil in Kerala of India as a sacred pilgrimage recognized by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 50% Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme of Sri Lanka Tea Board for 'Ceylon Tea' Exporters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Tea Board has been implementing the 50% Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme for Sri Lankan Tea Exporters since 2015 to facilitate Sri Lankan tea exporters to find new international buyers and promote their 'Ceylon Tea' brands globally. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantations and Community Infrastructure to continue the said Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creating a Digital Rubber Land Mapping/Registration System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The European Union has introduced new regulations (EUDR) that must be complied with when exporting rubber and rubber-related products to the countries of the European Union which is a major market for Sri Lankan rubber. Sri Lanka will also have to comply with the new regulations after 2025‑12‑31 to ensure that rubber supply chains do not contribute to deforestation. Accordingly, the need to create a Digital Rubber Land Mapping System has been identified to ensure that rubber supply chains do not contribute to deforestation. This project will geo-coordinate the rubber lands of small rubber plantation owners across the country and create a comprehensive and verifiable database on land ownership and use using innovative Geographic Information System (GIS) technology. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure to implement the project to create a Digital Rubber Land Mapping/Registration System, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing underutilized lands/properties under the State institutions  to Suitable Investors for optimal utilization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed through the Budget 2025 to identify underutilized lands under the institutions such as the Land Reform Commission, Regional Plantation Companies, National Livestock Development Board, Sri Lanka State Plantations Corporation, and Janatha Estate Development Board, and provide the said lands for private investments including small and medium scale enterprises so that they could be utilized for economically productive projects.  Under this programme, investment opportunities are expected to be provided for plantation/agricultural activities, plantation-related tourism promotion activities, livestock development, hydroelectric power generation, solar power generation, factory-related production activities, inland fisheries industry, and other plantation-related economic innovations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land & Irrigation for calling Expressions of Interest to select suitable investors for the identified lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with Belize
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to establish diplomatic relations with Latin American countries of Guatemala, Suriname, Belize, Honduras, Nicaragua, Antigua & Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica, Grenada, Haiti, St. Kits & Nevis, St. Lucia and St. Vincent and the Grenadines. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the Joint Communique on the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations between the Government of Sri lanka and the Government of Belize in order to enhance the friendly relations and cooperation in the political, socio-economic and cultural fields for mutual benefits of the two countries, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Implementation of the “District Development Programme - 2025”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Provisions of Rs.2,000 million have been allocated through the Budget 2025 to implement the District Development Programme as a national level development programme covering all Districts in Sri Lanka. Under the said programme, it is expected to achieve the following objectives;  *  Infrastructure improvement  *  Promotion of domestic production capabilities  *  Enhancing service delivery mechanisms  *  improving trade and marketing facilities  *  Strengthening institutional capacityThe proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Fiance, Planning and Economic Development to allocate provisions provided through the Budget Estimate 2025 to each District for the implementation of the District Development Programme - 2025, based on the District Poverty Level of Sri Lanka published by the Department of Census and Statistics using the Multidimensional Poverty Index which is a global measure used to identify poverty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 10,000 Vials of Tenecteplase Injection 40mg Vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 10,000 vials of Tenecteplase Injection 40mg Vial used for people with heart diseases. Three (03) bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement for a sum of USD 3.7 million to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s. Boehringer Ingelheim India Pvt. Ltd., India (Manufacturer: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co‑KG, Germany), based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Presidential Task Force for the implementation of the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A primary attention of the Government has been focused on taking necessary measures for the development of the tourism industry in creating a prosperous country under "A Modernized Tourist Industry - An Attractive Destination", in accordance with the current Government policy statement. The need to establish a Presidential Task Force has been identified, enabling to carry out these tasks more effectively and efficiently. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish a Presidential Task Force under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, with the representations of the relevant ministries, institutions and various sectors of the tourism field in order to achieve the rapid development goals and attain a high level substantial growth in the tourism industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the National Child Protection Authority Act, No.50 of 1998
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been about 25 years since the National Child Protection Authority Act, No. 50 of 1998 was passed. Due to the social, economic, political and cultural transformations that have taken place during this period, child abuse and violence against children have become complex in nature. Therefore, the necessity of amending the existing laws in a manner that suits the current needs to prevent and respond to all forms of abuse against children has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the National Child Protection Authority Act, No.50 of 1998, incorporating the amendments identified in order to perform the functions of the said Act in a more broad, meaningful and efficient manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Projects on Development of Sports Infrastructure Facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Developing human resources and sports infrastructure facilities in the field of sports to popularize sports is a main role of the Department of Sports Development. The Department of Sports Development has planned to implement three projects for the school system, public play grounds and youth clubs within a period of 03 years from the year 2025 with the aim of developing sports infrastructure facilities for the youth and elderly community, sports clubs and schools that do not have adequate sports facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to implement the Projects of Creating a sports culture, Providing sports infrastructure facilities for schools in rural areas and youth clubs and Development of infrastructure facilities in identified sports schools, by the Department of Sports Development during the period of 2025-2027, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 50 Polyaxial MRI compatible (Titanium/Cobolt-Chrome) Lumber pedicle screws and 20 instrument set for posterior thoracic Thoraco-lumber fusion (for scoliosis correction)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the purchase of 50 polyaxial MRI compatible lumbar pedicle screws used for spinal surgeries and 20 instrument sets for posterior thoracic Thoraco-lumbar fusion. Six bids and five bids have been received respectively for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement of 50 Lumbar pedicle screws to Avenierr Pharma (Pvt) Ltd. and the procurement of 20 instrument sets of posterior thoracic Thoraco-lumbar fusion equipment to A. Baur & Co. (Pvt) Ltd., based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 450,000 prefilled Syringes/Vials of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 6,000IU in 0.6ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 450,000 prefilled Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 6,000IU, 0.6ml Syringes/Vials used for the treatment of patients with heart diseases. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd., India (Manufacturer - M/s. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd., India) for a sum of USD 751,500, based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee on the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 900,000 prefilled Syringes/Vials of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 4,000IU in 0.4ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 900,000 prefilled Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 4,000IU, 0.4ml Syringes/Vials used for the treatment of patients with heart diseases. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s. Gland Pharma Limited, India (Manufacturer - M/s. Gland Pharma Limited, India) for a sum of USD 1.143 million, based on the recommendation of the Standing High‑Level Procurement Committee on the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-implementation of the housing projects of the Colombage Mawatha and Torrington Avenue under the Urban Regeneration Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑12‑30 to resume the initial works of the two housing projects in the Colombage Mawatha and Torrington Avenue which were implemented under the Urban Regeneration Project and had halted halfway. The Colombage Mawatha project consists of 615 housing units whereas the Torrington Avenue housing project consists of 115 housing units. The estimated cost for the implementation of the said projects is Rs.7.48 billion, and it is expected that it will take about 2 ½ years to complete the construction work. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to have the provisions required for the implementation of the said projects allocated from the year 2026 to the year 2028, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing a Dredger for the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A cost-benefit analysis has been conducted regarding the purchase of a dredger for the essential maintenance and development activities of the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation. The said Corporation requires to dredge about 183,000 cubic meters of sand annually, and since a cost of about Rs.500 million has to be incurred in obtaining the dredging service for that purpose from the private sector, purchasing a dredger for the Corporation itself has proven to be economically beneficial in the long term. Further, it is possible to use the dredger so purchased for dredging activities to be carried out in lagoons such as Arugam Bay, Nandikadal, Nayaru, Lankapatuna under the Lagoon Conservation and Management Programme implemented under the Ministry of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to purchase a dredger for the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Pettah Central Bus Stand under the 'Clean Sri Lanka' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to lack of repairs and modernizations over decades, the access roads, bus yards, passenger waiting areas, rest rooms for drivers and conductors, administrative buildings, sanitation and drainage systems of the Pettah Central Bus Stand are currently in a very dilapidated state. As a consequence, passengers using the Pettah Central Bus Stand, as well as drivers and conductors and the staff engaged in operational activities, face severe inconveniences. Therefore, the renovation and development of the Pettah Central Bus Stand to suit the present day has been identified as an urgent and timely need. It is estimated that approximately Rs.425 million will be incurred for the relevant modernization and development works. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to modernize and develop the Pettah Central Bus Stand, using the provisions allocated for the 'Clean Sri Lanka' programme, with the direct labor contribution of the Sri Lanka Air Force and with the contribution and cooperation of other relevant institutions including the Colombo Municipal Council, the Ceylon Electricity Board, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, the Road Development Authority and the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka Institute of Biotechnology (Pvt) Ltd. and the University of Illinois of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka Institute of Biotechnology (Pvt) Ltd. and the University of Illinois of the United States of America facilitating activities and programmes such as human resource skills development in genetic research and exchange of postgraduate students and staff. The concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism has been received for the proposed draft Memorandum of Understanding. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to sign the said MoU between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the coverage limit of Group Insurance policy for the Hon. Members of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑05-15 for the implementation of a group insurance policy for the Hon. Members of Parliament, subject to a maximum insurance coverage of Rs. 1 million per parliamentary year. Accordingly, relevant insurance coverages have been provided during the past period. At the time of presenting the Budget 2025, the Hon. President proposed to reduce the insurance coverage limit of Rs.1,000,000/- for a Member of Parliament to Rs.250,000/-. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to provide a group insurance policy for the Members of Parliament by limiting the insurance benefits for a Member of Parliament to Rs.250,000/- from the insurance year scheduled to commence on 2025‑10‑09 onwards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Standing Committee under the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW) was established in 1982 as a result of the declaration of a Charter on the Rights of Women by the United Nations General Assembly and adoption of the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women in 1979. Sri Lanka has ratified the said Convention and is responsible for following constitutional procedures, enacting legislation and providing periodic reports as required. Based on the recommendations made by the United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women in relation to Sri Lanka under the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women, the Ministry in charge of the subject of Women's Affairs, in collaboration with the Ministry in charge of the subject of Foreign Affairs and other relevant ministries/institutions, prepares a periodic report once in every 04 years. Accordingly, the Ninth (09) Periodic Report prepared by Sri Lanka has been submitted to the 90th Session of the United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women held in Geneva, Switzerland from 3rd to 21st February 2025. It has been identified the necessity of having an integrated approach regarding mandatory reporting and follow-up obligations, at a review held under the Chairmanship of the Hon. Prime Minister and with the participation of other parties, regarding the concluding observations on the Periodic Report made during that Session.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to establish an Inter-Ministerial Standing Committee, enabling to pursue action accordingly and to enter into relevant policy decisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulating a National Policy and Action Plan on Reconciliation and Coexistence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation Act, No.1 of 2024, the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation has been vested with power to formulate and implement a National Policy on Reconciliation and Coexistence and a National Action Plan. Accordingly, the Roadmap for Formulating National Policy and Action Plan on Reconciliation and Coexistence has been prepared by the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation.  The proposed National Policy and Action Plan seeks to achieve shared national aspirations such as strengthening institutional mechanisms, restoring public confidence, promoting inter-ethnic and inter-religious dialogue, and empowering youth and women as agents of peace. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to prepare a National Policy and Action Plan on Reconciliation and Coexistence for the period from 2025 - 2029 through a multi-stake holder approach, to establish an Inter-Ministerial Task Force comprising representatives of relevant Ministries and Line Agencies, and to obtain the necessary technical, logistical, financial and administrative support from the United Nations in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a new Delimitation Committee to review the recommendations of the Delimitation Committee held in the years 2012 and 2021 and submit recommendations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Delimitation Committee has been appointed in the year 2012 to establish and revise Divisional Secretariat Divisions and Grama Niladhari Divisions, and measures have been taken to implement only some of the recommendations of the said Committee. Subsequently, a Delimitation Committee has been appointed again in the year 2021, and no actions have been taken so far regarding the recommendations of the said Committee.  The proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to submit the recommendations of the said Committee Report to the relevant Regional Coordination Committees and District Coordination Committees and obtain their recommendations, and to appoint a new Delimitation Committee to review the said recommendations and submit a Report with recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Investments Proposals for the land called Chalmer's Granary located at Olcott Mawatha, Colombo Fort owned by the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The land of Chalmers Granary in extent of 09 acres 02 roods 31.75 perches (3.9248 hectares) located at Olcott Mawatha, Colombo Fort, owned by the Urban Development Authority, is located within the Compact Mixed Development Zone of the Development Plan prepared for the Colombo Municipal Council area for the period 2022-2031. It has been found appropriate to dispose the said land on a lease basis for the implementation of a mixed development project with higher financial, environmental and social potential, from among the permissible uses within the Compact Mixed Development Zone, including residential, healthcare, offices and corporate, commercial, educational, customer service centers, tourism, recreational and other activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to invite Investment Proposals from interested investors, to dispose the relevant land on a 99-year lease basis based on the updated valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creation of the Virtual City in Kandy under the Virtual City Creation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The city of Kandy, which houses the historic Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, has been identified to create in the name of Virtual City in Kandy as a pilot project of the Virtual City Creation Project. It has been planned to technically create 58 locations identified as priority sites with tourist attractions and tourist potential which are centered around the city of Kandy as the first part of the said pilot project and 20 locations of historical and tourism significance associated with the historical Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and its surroundings as the second phase of the project. The Ministry of Digital Economy has recommended Sri Lanka Telecom PLC as the suitable entity for the relevant work after evaluating the feasibility and technical capabilities of the production company and the previous production work carried out by the said Company. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to carry out the production activities of the Virtual City in Kandy Project by Sri Lanka Telecom PLC using the provisions allocated under the Clean Sri Lanka Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting 'Approved Enterprise' status to import Companies to re-export selected Spices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2023‑12‑18, has granted approval for the procedure for the importation and processing of selected spices for re-export purpose in the form of oil extracts, oleoresins and spent. Accordingly, the Import and Export (Control) Regulations No. 10 of 2024 have been imposed for the said purpose. Several enterprises have already signed Supplementary Agreements with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka for importing and processing selected spices as per the said Regulations. The Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has recommended to grant the 'Approved Enterprise' status to such enterprises. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon, President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to grant the 'Approved Enterprise' status to the following enterprises that have fulfilled the requirements of the procedure approved for re-export in the form of oil extracts, oleoresins and spent, was approved by the Cabinet. * Stay Naturals (Pvt) Ltd. * Verger Naturals (Pvt) Ltd. * Plant Lipids Lanka (Pvt) Ltd. * HDDES Extracts (Pvt) Ltd.

description: Statement on Financial Performance of the Government for the Second Quarter 2025s
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per section 53(1) of the Public Financial Management Act No.44 of 2024, the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance should submit a statement on financial performance including revenue and expenditure of the Government to the Cabinet at least on quarterly basis within a period of not less than 45 days after completion of each quarter. Accordingly, the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, having submitted the Report on Financial Performance prepared including cumulative revenue and expenditure reported by all Special Spending Units, Ministries, Departments, and District Secretariats for the second quarter ended on 2025‑06‑30, based on the classifications stated in Annual Budget Estimate for the year 2025, and the Cabinet Noted the said Report.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding under the Seasonal Worker Programme for Agriculture and Fisheries in the Republic of Korea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meetings held on 2025-02-19 and    2025‑07‑01, to implement a pilot project to facilitate the deployment of Sri Lankan workers under the E-8 visa category (seasonal workers) in the Republic of Korea and to hold discussions with the Korean counties who are interested for the same. Accordingly, as a result of the discussions held with the Boseong county of Korea, it has been agreed to recruit seasonal workers from Sri Lanka and enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for the same. The proposed Memorandum of Understanding will provide opportunity for Sri Lankans to work in agricultural villages in the Boseong County for a short period of time (up to a maximum of 8 months) under the Seasonal Worker Programme to earn an income and earn foreign exchange for the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding with the Boseong County, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Conservator General of Forests
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. E.A.P.N. Edirisinghe, who served as the Conservator General of Forests, has retired from the Public Service from 2025-07-08, on completion of the age of 60 years. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Environment, the Cabinet decided to appoint Mr. W.W.M.P.S.C. Palamakumbura, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service, presently serving as the Additional Conservator General of Forests (Forest Protection, Operations and Management) in the Department of Forest Conservation, to the vacant post of Conservator General of Forests, with immediate effect.

description: Parliamentary submission of Regulations made under section 41, to be read with section 31 of the Sports Law, No.25 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that various ambiguities have arisen due to the frequent amendment of the Sports Regulations issued in terms of the powers vested with the Minister in-charge of Sports by the provisions of the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973 and that the independence and impartiality that should prevail in sports are undermined by the politicization of sports. Therefore, with the objective of preventing fraud and corruption in sports and carrying forward sports in an independent and impartial manner, the National Sports Associations Regulations No.01 of 2025 have been made and published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2437/24 dated 2025-05-21 regarding the administration, functions, powers, duties and general provisions of the National Sports Associations. The proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Antiquities Ordinance, No. 9 of 1940 has been enacted for the conservation of antiquities of Sri Lanka and the sites and buildings with historical or archaeological importance in Sri Lanka. The said Ordinance was last amended in the year 1998 and the Department of Archaeology is currently facing a number of challenges in the protection of antiquities. Therefore, the need has arisen to amend the relevant Ordinance by incorporating new Laws to suit the current needs and to take prompt action, especially to prevent the destruction of antiquities, theft of antiquities, unauthorized excavations and export of antiquities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940, incorporating the amendments identified through conducting workshops and discussions with scholars in the relevant field, archaeologists, archaeological officers and social activists, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Presidents' Entitlements (Repeal) Bill in Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval on 2025-06-16 to prepare a Bill to repeal the Presidents' Entitlements Act, No.4 of 1986, enabling to abolish the special privileges granted to former Presidents and their families, as stated in the Government manifesto 'A thriving nation - A beautiful Life'. Accordingly, the Presidents' Entitlements (Repeal) Bill has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman for that purpose and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter to present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Institute of Real Estate Professionals, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meetings held on 2023-10-23 and 2025‑01‑20 pertaining to introducing a new Act enabling to establish an institution called the "Institute of Real Estate Professionals, Sri Lanka" to regulate the professional activities of real estate practitioners in Sri Lanka. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, as per the said approval. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to publish the Institute of Real Estate Professionals, Sri Lanka Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter to submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Civil Aviation (Imposition of Charges for Aerodrome Facilities) Regulations No.1 of 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka Act No. 34 of 2002, all the properties belonging to the Department of Civil Aviation have been transferred to the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the relevant Orders for the transfer of the Bandaranaike International Airport, Ratmalana Airport, Jaffna International Airport and Batticaloa International Airport to the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka have been published through Gazette Notifications. Further, as per the provisions of the Civil Aviation Act No. 14 of 2010, Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited has been appointed as the statutory service provider for the development, operation and maintenance of the airports. Accordingly, the Civil Aviation (Imposition of Charges for Aerodrome Facilities) Regulations No.1 of 2025, have been imposed by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2422/38 dated 2025‑02‑06, pertaining to the payment of an annual nominal fee by Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited for the use of the said airports vested with the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka. The proposal made by the Minister to present the said Regulations in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Coal for the Lakvijaya Power Plant, Norochcholai for the forthcoming season of 2025-2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Electricity Board has estimated that the coal requirement of the Norochcholai Lakvijaya Power Plant for the season 2025/2026 will be 2.32 million MT  ± 10% (39 shipments). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy, to invite bids for the procurement of coal from registered suppliers of Lanka Coal Company(Pvt) Ltd. for the said period , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Expressions of Interest to purchase medicines and other medicinal supplies from Local Manufacturers for the year 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Twenty-four (24) manufacturers have been selected to locally procure 130 medicines and medicinal supplies for the year 2025 by calling Expressions of Interest from local manufacturers and having evaluated them by a Committee appointed by the Secretary, Ministry of Health and Mass Media. The agreements entered into with these manufacturers are scheduled to expire on 2025‑12‑31. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to invite Expressions of Interest/Requests for Proposals from local manufacturers for the purchase of locally manufactured medicines and other medical supplies for the year 2026, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for Ground Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines Limited at Dhaka Airport (DAC) in Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ground Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines Limited at Dhaka Airport is being provided by Biman Bangladesh Airlines Limited, the sole service provider of ground handling services in that airport and the duration of the said contract is scheduled to expire on 2025‑09‑30. A proposal has been obtained from that company to extend the duration of the said project. Based on the recommendations submitted by the Bid Evaluation Committee and the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the same, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to award the relevant contract to the said company for a period of 03 years from 2025‑10‑01 to 2028‑09-30, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contracts for the Aviation Insurance Policies and Aviation Insurance Services of SriLankan Airlines Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the Limited National Competitive Procurement Method for the procurement of 04 Aviation Insurance Policies for SriLankan Airlines Limited from 2025‑08‑11 to 2026‑08‑10 and for obtaining Aviation Insurance Services from 2025‑08‑11 to 2028‑08‑10. Three (03) bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the said contracts to Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation General Limited, based on the recommendations of the Bid Evaluation Committee and the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project to establish a Threat Hunting and Malware Analysis Lab
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka expects to accelerate its digital transformation through major projects such as the Sri Lanka Unique Digital Identity, the National Federated Data Exchange and the Lanka Government Cloud, and other digitalization projects operating within the government institutions. Creating a secured cyber environment has been identified as a critical requirement for the successful implementation of such projects. For this purpose, a project has been planned to establish a research unit within the Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team (Sri Lanka CERT) aiming enhancing the capability of identifying and successful countering of cyber-attacks, advanced malware analysis capabilities and human resource capacity building and research. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy to implement the proposed project to establish a sThreat Hunting and Malware Analysis Lab, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transferring the ownership of lands allocated for the establishment of the Nanotechnology Science Park and the establishment of the Faculty of Technology, University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has acquired a plot of land in extent of 91.40 hectares (225 acres, 3 roods, 4.14 perches) located at Mahenawatte area of Pitipana, Homagama for the purpose of enhancing science and technology-related development activities and establishment of associated institutions. The Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority has granted approval for allocation of 02 plots of land from the said lands for the establishment of the Nanotechnology Science Park and the Faculty of Technology of the University of Colombo. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to transfer the ownership of 19.25 hectares (47 acres 2 roods 10.8 perches) to the Ministry of Science and Technology for the establishment of the Nanotechnology Science Park and 7.18 hectares (17 acres 2 roods 37.74 perches) to the University Grants Commission for the establishment of the Faculty of Technology of the University of Colombo, subject to levying the relevant assessment value, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing an Action Plan between the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy and the Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2023‑05‑29, has granted approval to extend the Memorandum of Understanding signed in the year 2016 with the objective of formally continuing the scientific collaboration between the Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute and the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy, for a further period of five years. As per the said Memorandum of Understanding, a consensus has been reached to sign an Action Plan for a period of five years between the two parties. It was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet to the proposal submitted by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to sign the said Action Plan.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding on Diplomatic Training and Exchange of Information and Documentation with the Foreign Service Institute of the Republic of Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute of Sri Lanka, which has been established to train officers of the Sri Lanka Foreign Service, and the Foreign Service Institute of Maldives, with the aim of promoting mutual cooperation and enhance understanding. Through this Agreement, it is expected to exchange information on study programmes and other academic activities, exchange of academics, conference speakers and experts in areas of common interest, providing opportunities for diplomats of both countries in trainings offered by each other and organizing courses and seminars in the cities of Colombo and Male. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute of Sri Lanka and the Foreign Service Institute of Maldives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding for Higher Education Collaboration under the Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary and the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education of Sri Lanka to further strengthen the mutual cooperation in the field of higher education of both countries by creating a knowledge based society. This Agreement, which is an extension to the Memorandum of Understanding entered into for the period of 2022‑2024, will provide the Sri Lankan students with Bachelor's Degree and Postgraduate Degree opportunities. Under the Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme, Sri lankan students will receive annually 20 scholarship opportunities as 08 for Bachelor's Degrees, 08 for Postgraduate Degrees and 04 for PhD's under the fields of Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Medicine, Health Sciences and Agriculture as direct benefits of the Agreement. It has been planned to implement the proposed Memorandum of Understanding during the period from 2025-2027. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Seeking Cooperation of AI Singapore for the Development of Artificial Intelligence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Discussions have been held with the "AI Singapore" operating under the National University of Singapore to explore active partnerships and opportunities for knowledge sharing which could contribute to the strategic objectives of Sri Lanka for the development of Artificial Intelligence. For this purpose, a proposal has been submitted for signing a Memorandum of Understanding to formalize the cooperation between the two countries thereby aiming to initiate joint research initiatives, artificial intelligence training programmes and mutual assistance for the development of artificial intelligence technologies enabling to face the local and global challenges. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Digital Economy of Sri Lanka and the National University of Singapore, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taxation on Cross Border E-Commerce
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the volume of imports into Sri Lanka through cross border e-commerce has also increased significantly with the rapid growth of e-commerce. The Government should organize the collection of tax revenue from e-commerce to improve e-commerce, which brings significant economic benefits by creating a supportive regulatory environment. Sri Lanka Customs has recently revised its Customs Clearance Procedure identifying certain lapses in the Customs Clearance Procedure followed regarding imports made through e-commerce platforms. The delays, increased transaction costs, eroded public trust, and reduced transparency and predictability of prices resulting from its implementation have led to dissatisfaction among users of e-commerce platforms. In particular, individual consumers and small-scale importers who rely heavily on e-commerce have been affected. The proposal made by the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint a Committee comprising officials from relevant institutions to provide transitional operational relief for e-commerce and to introduce a long-term regulatory framework in this regard, in view of this situation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Regulations of the Shop and Office Employees 	(Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.19 of 1954
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Shop and Office Employees 	(Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.19 of 1954, has prescribed provisions relating to service facilities, working hours, overtime allowances and leave for shop and office employees, and the Minister in charge of the subject of Labour has been vested the power to make relevant regulations in accordance with the said Act. Under the existing Regulations, a female employee who has completed the age of 18 years may be employed in a residential hotel in the duty of a female receptionist, ladies linen room attendant, ladies cloak-room attendant, or ladies lavatory attendant after 6.00 pm and before 6.00 am. However, since Food and Beverage Stewardesses serving in residential hotels and restaurants could be employed only until 10.00 pm, it has been reported that various problematic situations arise in carrying out their operations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to amend the Regulation No.3 issued under the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.19 of 1954, enabling to allow female employees above the age of 18 years engaged in the duties of Food and Beverage Stewardesses in residential hotels and restaurants to be employed after 6.00 pm and before 6.00 am, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project of improving the capacity of secondary healthcare hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: The Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide US$ 100 million as result based budget support for the programme to enhance the quality and capacity of secondary care hospitals across the country. The proposed project aims to standardize the service capacity and quality of the secondary healthcare hospitals and strengthen the transparency and efficiency of pharmaceutical supply chain, health procurement and financing system. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement this project from 2025 to 2030, using the said funds provided through the Results-Based Lending modality, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Treatment Plants for improvement of sewage 	management By Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The lack of adequate sewage treatment plants has become an obstacle for fulfilling the sewage management service chain in the island. As a result, in certain instances, collected sewage is disposed to the open environment improperly. Under the National Policy on Waste Management, the need to improve the infrastructure facilities required for sewage  management has been identified.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government for the construction of mechanical sewage treatment plants in selected Local Authorities, utilizing Rs. 200 million from the provisions allocated for the Clean Sri Lanka Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 400,000 vials of Desferrioxamine Mesylate for Injection BP, 500mg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the International Competitive Bidding Method for the purchase of 400,000 vials of Desferrioxamine Mesylate Injection BP 500 mg, which is used to remove excess iron from the body in anemia or thalassemia patients. Two bidders have submitted bids for the purpose. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to M/s. ABC Pharma Services (Pvt) Ltd., Sri Lanka, the sole responsive bidder, based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 05 power sets for the Department of Sri Lanka 	Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Sri Lanka Railways does not currently possess a number of power sets suitable to be deployed for suburban passenger trains. Therefore, there is a constant passenger congestion in the trains that are operated daily. Since most of the existing power sets have been in operation for over 20 years, they are constantly subject to sudden outages and breakdowns. Under that backdrop, it is observed that passengers who use the train for their daily activities are facing many inconveniences. At least 96 power sets are required to maintain the currently scheduled train services, and at the moment there is a shortage of several power sets. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to procure 05 power sets to be deployed in suburban and long distance services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Online Application for Passports through Sri Lanka Missions/Posts Abroad
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been submitted to the International Organization for Migration (IOM) for obtaining support to conduct passport applications process made by Sri Lankans through Sri Lankan Missions Abroad/ Posts abroad online in order to expedite the said process. Accordingly, the International Organization for Migration has agreed to provide funds for implementing a project to supply biometric capture centers and related equipment covering 20 Missions/Posts Abroad, and to develop systems/software to facilitate and integrate online connectivity with the Department of Immigration and Emigration and provide necessary technical support. The implementation of this project aims to facilitate overseas Sri Lankans to obtain passports quickly and easily using digital technology. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism and the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to implement the project for passport applications through online via 20 identified Sri Lanka Missions/Posts Abroad from this year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Cyber Security Strategy of Sri Lanka  - 2025-2029
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka's first Information and Cyber Security Strategy, introduced in 2018, has been implemented from the year 2019 to 2023. Based on the first Cyber Security Strategy and with the support of the World Bank, the Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team (Sri Lanka CERT) has developed the 'National Cyber Security Strategy of Sri Lanka 2025-2029' on cyber security. The said Strategy has been drafted based on the strategic areas such as strengthening the legal and regulatory framework, improving knowledge, enhancing cyber security preparedness and strengthening response capabilities, and increasing collaboration, covering only the civilian domain related to cyber security in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy for the implementation of the said 'National Cyber Security Strategy of Sri Lanka 2025-2029', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the post of Commissioner General of Excise
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. U.L. Udaya Kumara Perera, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Inland Revenue Service, presently serving as the Commissioner General of Excise, is due to retire from the Public Service upon completion of the age of 60 years on 2025-07-10. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint Mr. M.B.N.A. Pemarathna, retired Commodore of the Sri Lanka Navy, to the post of Commissioner General of Excise falling vacant accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 2.2 million vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection (Human) 30% soluble 70% Isophane
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Limited National Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 2.2 million vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection which is used for the treatment of diabetic patients. Only M/s M.J. Biopharma Private Limited, India has submitted a bid for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to the said company, based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Justices of the Peace Regulations No.1 of 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Mediation Boards Commission has submitted a request to grant recognition as ex-officio Justice of the Peace to the mediators of the Mediation Boards Commission, in accordance with the provisions of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to submit the Justices of the Peace Regulations No.1 of 2025, published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2440/27 dated 2025‑06‑23,  to appoint every mediator as an ex‑officio Justice of the Peace for the respective Mediation Board area during his tenure, to Parliament for approval,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Construction Industry Development (Registration of Adjudicators) Regulation of 2019 and the Construction Industry Development (Registration of Contractors) Regulations, No.1 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to submit the following Regulations, made under the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014 and published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2430/13 dated 2025-04-01, to Parliament for approval, by amending the Construction Industry Development (Registration of Adjudicators) Regulation of 2019 published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2113/63 dated 2019-03-08 and the Construction Industry Development (Registration of Contractors) Regulations, No.1 of 2017 published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2057/5 dated 2018‑02‑05, was approved by the Cabinet.* Regulations made under section 58 of the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014, read with subsection (2) of section 52 of the aforesaid Act.* Regulations made under section 58 of the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014,  read with subsections (1), (2) and (4) of section 35 of the aforesaid Act.

description: Repealing the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 and introducing a new Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has been granted at its meeting held on 2024-12-30 to introduce a new Act repealing the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 and to appoint a committee to examine the initial draft prepared for the said purpose and submit an initial draft incorporating suitable amendments. Accordingly, the relevant Committee has prepared an amended draft with the appropriate amendments. The proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a new Bill, based on the said amended initial draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing an allowance for Dhamma school teachers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Dhamma school education provides a good basis for directing the society towards spiritual development. Therefore, it has been identified that it is more suitable to provide a teachers allowance and uniform allowance to teachers serving in Dhamma schools without expectation of any personal gain to encourage them for obtaining their continuous services and protect their identity and also for the advancement of Dhamma education which is essential for the well-being of the society. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to pay a one-time annual payment of Rs.7,500/- as an allowance including teacher's allowance and uniform allowance to the teachers who have completed one year of continuous service in registered Dhamma Schools belonging to the Buddhist, Hindu, Islamic, Christian and Catholic religions, from the year 2026 onwards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project of Proper and Clean Maintenance of Reservoirs and Waterways in the Western Province under the “Clean Sri Lanka - 2025 programme”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Many canals which are not maintained by any government agency are located in the Colombo-North and in densely populated areas in the Colombo city. Therefore, a project has been designed to implement under the "Clean Sri Lanka" programme to clean and maintain the secondary canals that are not so maintained and as well as to increase the frequency of cleaning the main canals around Colombo City. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to implement the proposed project through the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation under the "Clean Sri Lanka" programme with the following objectives:* Controlling flooding in the Colombo City by rainwater thereby minimizing public distress caused by the same.* Maintaining a clean, pleasant and healthy environment.* Enhancing public health and quality of life.* Increasing the city's attraction to tourists.* Improving the quality of water in inland waterways and water retention basins.

description: Implementing an integrated programme for the future advancement of the Sri Lankan Youth
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports is entrusted with the responsibility on the functions of formulating, monitoring and evaluating policies, strategies and programmes related to youth development in Sri Lanka. The National Youth Services Council, the Youth Corps and the National Centre for Leadership Development, Embilipitiya, under the purview of the said Ministry, work to empower the youth community through leadership development, skills training and vocational education. It has been observed that it is essential to have an integrated and collaborative approach among the government institutions with the potential of intervention for the advancement of living and economic status of the youth community receiving vocational education. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports, to arrange an integrated programme by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports; Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education; Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism; and the Ministry of Digital Economy and to appoint a Ministerial Committee to implement the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Royal Canadian Mounted Police and the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Royal Canadian Mounted Police and the Sri Lanka Police have reached a consensus to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties for the development of cooperation. It is anticipated to prevent transnational organized crimes, exchange information on suspects and crimes, conduct joint operations and obtain technical assistance. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism has extended its concurrence to the proposed Memorandum of Understanding. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to enter into the said Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Treaty between Sri Lanka and Maldives on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The absence of an Agreement on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters between Sri Lanka and the Maldives has led to many difficulties in engaging in joint investigations. Therefore, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑09‑22 to enter into an Agreement between the two countries, the relevant Agreement has not yet been signed. The Maldivian Government has extended its concurrence to the proposed draft Agreement and the clearance of the Attorney General has also been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to sign the Treaty on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting a plot of land to the Ceylon College of Physicians on long term lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A plot of land in extent of 30 perches located in Welikada, Rajagiriya has been granted to the Ceylon College of Physicians on long-term lease basis for a period of 30 years with effect from 1999‑05‑13 at an annual lease rent of 0.5% of the market value as assessed by the Chief Government Valuer. The said lease period is scheduled to expire in 2029. The institute has requested to obtain the said land again on a long-term lease basis, so that a significant investment can be made and the head office of the said institute which has been erected and is currently in a dilapidated condition can be renovated. At the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑06‑24, approval has been granted to lease the said plot of land for a period of 50 years, on the basis of collecting the annual lease rent as determined by the Chief Government Valuer. However, a request has been made to grant the relevant land on long-term lease basis at a concessional annual rent as per the provisions of the lease agreement currently in force, stating that the said institute is a non-profit making institution established solely for the purpose of promoting research in the advancement of medical knowledge, and therefore it is not in a position to pay a high rental amount. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to lease the relevant land to the Ceylon College of Physicians for a period of 50 years based on the provisions of the Agreement which is currently in force, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of lands where the Rest Houses are located with the Urban Development Authority for the development by investors for management and operational activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The management and governance of properties of government-owned Rest Houses established in various areas of the island since the colonial period have been assigned to the Urban Development Authority and Local Authorities. Although these Rest Houses are located in tourist-attractive areas, they have fallen into a dilapidated and deteriorated condition due to poor management and governance. Development of these Rest Houses to suit the current economic environment will enable to provide a cost-effective and higher quality service to the general public and create a source of income generation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to transfer 44 sites where dilapidated and deteriorated Rest Houses are located at present to the Urban Development Authority as a free grant, in accordance with the provisions of the State Lands Ordinance, enabling to develop the same through calling for Project Proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Incorporation of a limited liability company to manage and operate the East Container Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2021‑02‑01 for the Colombo South Port Project - Development of the East Container Terminal and the West Container Terminal. It has been decided at the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority to incorporate a limited liability company fully owned by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority to operate and manage the East Container Terminal. This would enable to accrue maximum economic benefits, achieve operational efficiency and compete with other private terminal operators. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to incorporate a Company named "Colombo East Container Terminal (Private) Limited", was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Convention between Sri Lanka and Austria for Elimination of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion and Avoidance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to reach a Convention between Sri Lanka and Austria to enhance economic relations between the two countries by establishing the necessary legal framework for elimination of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion and avoidance. Although some revenue may be lost due to the concessions offered through the proposed Agreement, the benefits that could be accrued upon the foreign investment promotion and significant increase in foreign exchange earnings will be advantageous to the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to sign the said Convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Progress of the Mega Scale Development Projects by the end of the First Quarter of the year 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Project Management and Monitoring has presented the Performance Report on Mega Scale Development Projects having reviewed the performance data and information submitted by the relevant Ministries regarding the financial and physical progress of Mega Scale Development Projects implemented by Line Ministries by the end of the first quarter of 2025,  According to the said Report, by the end of the first quarter of 2025, 205 Large-Scale Development Projects including 21 newly added projects are at on-going status. Furthermore, it is expected to complete 145 projects including 74 projects that were scheduled to be completed before the first quarter of 2025 in the year 2025, 24 projects in 2026, 19 projects in 2027, and 09 projects in 2028. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development for all relevant Ministries and other authorities to take necessary action to complete these projects within the targeted timeframes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting approval to the Sri Lanka Navy to conduct Maritime Security Operations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The International Maritime Organization has designated the Somali maritime region, including the Gulf of Aden and the Red Sea as a High‑Risk Area in the year 2010 due to the pirate activities that merchant vessels engaged in international trade have had to face. As a remedy for such threats, merchant vessels entering the High-Risk Area obtain the service of armed sea marshals through foreign private maritime security companies. Although the International Maritime Organization revoked the High-Risk Area status from 2023‑01‑01, commercial vessels have continued to obtain the service of the private maritime security companies.
