Ports of Galle and Colombo are primarily used for the embarkation and disembarkation of armed sea marshals deployed to protect merchant vessels entering to and departing from the said maritime zones and occasionally the ports of Hambantota and Trincomalee are also used for such maritime security operations. The Sri Lanka Navy has been entrusted with the overall responsibility for national security in carrying out operational activities of the said project. Therefore, taking into consideration the knowledge and experience of the Sri Lanka Navy in relation to maritime security operations, it has been found appropriate to grant approval to the Sri Lanka Navy as well to carry out maritime security operations independently. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence for maritime security operations to be carried out by the Sri Lanka Navy under the supervision of the Ministry of Defence, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Three-Member Committee to inquire into the activities of the Central Cultural Fund during the period from the year 2017 to 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been reported that various financial irregularities have occurred in providing financial assistance to religious places and various activities by the Central Cultural Fund during the period from the year 2017 to 2020. It has been decided at the 223rd meeting of the Board of Governors of the Central Cultural Fund held on 2025‑05‑17 to appoint a Committee to inquire into the alleged irregularities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to appoint a Three-Member Committee under the Chairmanship of Justice G.M.W. Pradeep Jayathilaka, retired High Court Judge, for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Presidential Special Committee of Inquiry to inquire into the Fraud, Corruptions and Irregularities which have occurred in Sri Lankan Airlines Ltd, and Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Ltd, during the past period
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although Sri Lankan Airlines Limited has contributed towards the economic prosperity of the country, the Government has to bear excessive burden to maintain it, and the heavy annual loss incurred by the company is difficult for the country's economy to bear. It is the desire of the public to transform this Company into an economically beneficial, efficient and productive state-owned institution and to successfully maintain it using modern technology. For this purpose, a formal study and evaluation on the transactions and incidents that have taken place in the past period which led to the current situation of SriLankan Airlines Limited should be carried out.  Similarly, the need to investigate the activities of Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Ltd, which is responsible for airport operations, has been brought to the attention of the Government by various parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to appoint a Presidential Special Committee of Inquiry, chaired by the former Auditor General, Mr. H.M. Gamini Wijesinghe, to inquire into the frauds, corruptions and irregularities alleged to have occurred in the above institutions during the period of 2010-2025 and submit a comprehensive Report with recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Justices of the Peace (Appointment, Suspension, Cancellation and Code of Conduct) Regulations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Provisions of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 have empowered the Minister to make regulations for the appointment, suspension, cancellation and termination of the office of a Justice of the Peace. Accordingly, the Justices of the Peace (Appointment, Suspension, Cancellation, and Code of Conduct) Regulations No.3 of 2023 has been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2360/22 dated 2023 11 27. Amended Regulations by amending the said Regulations have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2439/34 dated 2025 06 04. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of Intra Ocular Lens
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited under the International Competitive Bidding Procedure for the supply of 05 categories of Intra Ocular Lens which are used to implant in the eye for cataract or myopia treatments. 05 bidders have submitted bids for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass media to procure the relevant 05  Intra Ocular Lens from the following suppliers, based on the recommendations of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

•	supplying  Intra Ocular Lens from M/s Elshaddai Enterprises (Pvt) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder pertaining to procurements of SR No.13005029 and 13005032.

•	supplying  Intra Ocular Lens from M/s Jayasuriya Associates, the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder pertaining to procurements of SR No.13005026, 13005031 and 13005030.

description: The Methodology of Purchasing medicines and medicinal equipment 	under Government to Government basis, where found necessary
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  at the  meeting  held  on 2025-05-19 to appoint a Senior Officials' Committee to prepare a methodology for selecting countries with potential to procure medicines of short supply under the  Government-to-Government basis. Accordingly, the draft methodology prepared by the Committee has been forwarded to the National Procurement Commission, and a methodology has been prepared for the procurement of medicines and medical equipment under Government-to-Government basis, based on the proposals and observations of the said Commission. The proposal made by the Minister of  Health and Mass Media, to enter into Memoranda of Understanding with the countries having the potential to purchase medicines and medicinal equipment as per the said methodology, in essential instances, and to enter into agreements with the institutions nominated by those Governments by the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation and secure medicines and medicinal equipment that are difficult to procure through the normal supply chain, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selection of Consultancy Firms for the supervision activities of the Housing Programme implemented for low-income families under Government of China Assistance Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Urban Development Authority has invited Expressions of Interest to select a consultancy firm under 03 packages for residential site supervision consultancy services of 1996 housing units constructed for low-income families under the Government of China Assistance Programme. 06 institutions have submitted  Expressions of Interest for the same and 03 institutions out of them have been qualified to submit Request for Proposals. The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to award the relevant contract for supplying consultancy services as follows, based on the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet. Package 1 - Awarding the Consultancy Service Contract of the Project for the construction of 575 housing units in Moratuwa and 108 housing units in Kottawa, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau.
 
Package 2 - Awarding the Consultancy Service Contract of the Project for the construction of 586 housing units in Dematagoda and 112 housing units in Maharagama,  to the State Engineering Corporation.

Package 3 - Awarding the Consultancy Service Contract of the Project for the construction of 615 housing units in Peliyagoda  to the State  Engineering Corporation.

description: Improving sanitation facilities in the urban areas throughout the 	island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Due to the lack of sanitation facilities of proper standard for the use of the public and local and foreign tourists who flock to urban areas daily, the Government has decided to construct sanitation facilities equipped with standard toilet systems. The Urban Development Authority has identified suitable locations for the proposed facilities as per the urban development plans. It is proposed to construct 20 sanitation facilities under the said project, and it is estimated that Rs. 525.29 million will be incurred for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to implement the proposed sanitation facilities construction project at the following locations, was approved by the Cabinet:

		*	Demodara Railway Station
		*	Hotel Junction, Sigiriya
		*	Lake Round, Kandy
		*	Gregory Lake, Nuwara Eliya
		*	Kinniya Beach, Trincomalee
		*	Marble Brach, Trincomalee
		*	Nilaveli Beach Area,Trincomalee
		*	Passikudah,Batticaloa
		*	Ruwanweliseya car park premises
		*	Lankapura,Polonnaruwa
		*	Kurikaduwan Jetty premises, Jaffna
		*	Hikkaduwa Coastal Gateway Hub
		*	Hiriketiya, Dikwella
		*	Pareiwella Beach park, Tangalle
		*	Nine Arch Bridge, Ella
		*	Moragolla beach,Beruwala
		*	Railway station, Mount Lavinia
		*	Negombo beach park project, Stage I
		*	Battaramulla Junction
		*	Badagamuwa Forest Park, Kurunegala

description: Sri Lanka Expo - 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Export Development Board has conducted the Sri Lanka Expo in the years 1992, 1994, 1997 and 2012. After 14 years, it has been planned to conduct the Sri Lanka Expo from 2026 06 18 to 2026 06 21 at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall, Colombo.  It is expected to attract 1500 exporters, export ready SMEs and buyers and investors for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to organize the Sri Lanka Expo - 2026 as a national event, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of a Public Debt Management Software System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-10-14 to obtain a bid from the Commonwealth Secretariat for the purchase of a  Debt Management Software System required for the Public Debt Management by following the direct procurement procedure. Accordingly, a bid has been submitted by the Commonwealth Secretariat. The Bid Evaluation Committee and the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee have recommended that the contract for the installation of the Commonwealth Meridian Software System be awarded to the Commonwealth Secretariat at an annual maintenance fee of 12,500 GBP. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the contract for the installation of the said software and related services in the Department of External Resources, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Research Projects on Palm Leaf Manuscript collections with Sri Lankan origin in Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Based on a proposal submitted in response to an international call for research proposals on collections with colonial context by the Dutch Research Council, the Department of National Archives in Sri Lanka, together with five partners including the Free University of the Netherlands, have been awarded a competitive grant of EUR 384,248 to conduct research on palm leaf collections of Sri Lankan origin in Netherlands. The proposed research will be carried out between 2025 and 2029 under the title "Whose Knowledge, Whose Values? Palm Leaf Manuscripts and the Question of Colonial Collections in Dutch Heritage Institutions". The Agreement to be signed between the six joint stakeholders to implement the said project has received the clearance of the Attorney General, the recommendation of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism and the concurrence of the Department of External Resources. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to sign the proposed Agreement and to conduct the said Research during the period 2025 - 2029, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Five Year National Action Plan on National Policy on Child Protection
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2019-10-29 for the "National Policy on Child Protection" prepared in accordance with the provisions of the National Child Protection Authority Act, No.50 of 1998. In order to implement the said National Policy, the "Five-Year National Action Plan for the National Child Protection Policy" has been prepared, taking into account the views and suggestions of the parties working on it, covering ten (10) subject areas related to child protection. This Five-Year National Action Plan has been prepared with a multi-sectoral approach in line with the policy commitments of the National Policy Framework for "Secure world for children - Creative future generation". Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to implement the said National Action Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Community Productive Model Villages programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement the Community Productive Model Villages Programme based on the Participatory Rural Approach by selecting one village (approximately 50 families) from each of the Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the years 2025, 2026 and 2027, in line with the Clean Sri Lanka National Project, as a strategic tool to achieve its objectives islandwide. This programme aims to create the selected villages as Community Productive Model Villages based on the model criteria identified under the areas of education, economy, health and sanitation, household management and social well-being, culture and spiritual development and environmental conservation. The selection of suitable villages for the proposed programme will be carried out in collaboration with the District Secretaries and Divisional Secretaries. Under this programme, it is expected to empower all field officers belonging to the line Ministries serving in the Divisional Secretariats representing each selected village and to fulfill the needs of the villagers through those officers efficiently and effectively. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development to implement the proposed programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Seasonal Worker Programme for Agriculture and Fisheries in Republic of Korea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-02-19 for the implementation of a pilot project to facilitate the deployment of Sri Lankan workers under the E-8 visa category (Seasonal Workers) in the Republic of Korea. Accordingly, discussions have been held through diplomatic channels with interested Counties of the Republic of Korea to enter into Memoranda of Understanding. As a result of the discussions held with the Yeongwol County in  Republic of Korea, it has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties. The proposed Memorandum of Understanding will provide the opportunity to Sri Lankans to work in the agricultural and fisheries villages of Yeongwol County for a short period of time (5 to 8 months) under the Seasonal Worker Programme to earn an income and earn foreign exchange for this Country. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the proposed Memoranda of Understanding. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the relevant Memorandum of Understanding with the Yeongwol County, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of the Budget for the year 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Budget for the year 2026 is expected to be prepared adhering to the          2026-2030 Fiscal Framework and the Fiscal Strategy Statement and the National Policy Framework "A Thriving Nation - A Beautiful Life", based on the theme  "A Productive Economy and Foster the Engagement of Everyone in Economic Development". It is expected to give special priority to the priorities outlined in the National Policy Framework and rural development initiatives when preparing the 2026 Budget Estimates. Proposals are to be obtained from all Ministries to provide the necessary provisions for the implementation of the projects and programmes identified by each Ministry under the subjects and functions of the Ministries in accordance with the provisions of the Public Finance Management Act, No. 44 of 2024 and the Government Policy Statement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to prepare the Budget for the year 2026, enabling to present the Appropriation Bill for the year 2026 in Parliament in October 2025, conduct the Second Reading (Budget Speech) in November 2025 and to conduct the Third Reading Budget Debate in November and December 2025, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Scholarship programme to provide opportunities for top-performers  of the G.C.E.(Advanced Level) Examination to pursue their Bachelor's degree in foreign universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to fulfill the goal of creating "A civilized citizen - An advanced human resource" as per the Government Policy Statement, a provision of Rs. 200 million has been allocated through the Budget Proposal - 2025 to implement a programme to provide scholarships to the top-performers of the G.C.E. (Advanced Level) Examination to pursue their Bachelor's degree in internationally high ranked foreign universities. Under this scholarship programme, it is proposed to award scholarships to complete Degree courses for a maximum of 04 years from foreign universities teaching in English-medium that are among the top 500 in the international university ranking indices. It has been planned to award scholarships to 200 students through this programme under a five-year plan and in its first phase, it is expected to select a number of students from 20-50 for the year 2025. Students with the highest Z-Score under the main subject streams of the G.C.E. (Advanced Level) Examination will be given the opportunity to apply for this. The selection of the suitable students from among the said applications will be done by an expert interview panel comprising of the university professors and lecturers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement the proposed Scholarship Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Situation which has arisen in the Middle East Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet drew its attention regarding the necessity of having a prior preparedness pertaining to the challenges Sri Lanka would have to face in the future due to the intense war situation which has broken out by now in the Middle East Region. Accordingly, Cabinet decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee with the following composition to closely observe the war situation in the Middle East and conduct a review on the likely impact on all sectors, the scale of such impact and the expeditious measures to be taken in that regard and submit recommendations where found necessary and to appoint a Committee comprising of the Secretaries to the relevant Ministries to assist the said Cabinet Sub‑Committee:* Hon. Vijitha Herath,  Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism- (Chairman).* Hon. Samantha Viddyarathna,  Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure.* Hon. Wasantha Samarasinghe,  Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development.* Hon. (Eng.) Kumara Jayakody,  Minister of Energy.

description: Further strengthening the Administrative Structure of the Tourism Industry in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The policy concurrence of the Cabinet of Ministers has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-01-20 to introduce a new Act to replace the Tourism Act, No.38 of 2005. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill based on the Concept Paper prepared by an Expert Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Standard Operating Procedure for Law Enforcement Authorities on detection, investigation and prosecution of trafficking-related organized crimes against children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Child trafficking for exploitation is considered a grave human rights violation as well as a serious organized international crime. Accordingly, Sri Lanka is committed to strengthening its national response through legal institutions and a procedural mechanism adhering to its obligations under the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child and other international policy frameworks. The Ministry of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs, in collaboration with the Women and Children's Bureau, various units of the Criminal Investigation Department of the Sri Lanka Police, the National Child Protection Authority, the Attorney General’s Department and other relevant stakeholders, has developed a comprehensive Standard Operating Procedure titled “Standard Operating Procedures for Law Enforcement Authorities on Detection, Investigation and Prosecution of Trafficking-Related Organized Crimes Against Children”. The said Standard Operating Procedure has received the clearance of the Attorney General. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to publish the Standard Operating Procedure for law enforcement authorities on the detection, investigation and prosecution of trafficking-related organized crimes against children, in the Government Gazette, enabling the relevant stakeholders to properly implement the said Standard Operating Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance and the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 (Prohibition against trafficking of dangerous drugs on high seas)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The proposal submitted to amend the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance and Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 (Prohibition against trafficking of dangerous drugs on the High Seas) was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-02-09. In that instance, the Cabinet has granted its concurrence to obtain the views of all relevant parties and to prepare an Initial Draft/Concept Paper.  Accordingly, the views of the relevant parties were obtained and the amendments to the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance and the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 have been identified. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to instruct the Legal Draftsman to take steps to prepare Bills to amend the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance and the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, based on the said amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting the Public Procurement Law
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the powers vested by the Constitution, the National Procurement Commission has obtained the services of an international consultant and two local consultants to draft the Public Procurement Law with the support of the Asian Development Bank. The National Procurement Commission has taken steps to further improve the initial draft prepared by them by obtaining the views and proposals of all parties including foreign agencies, Heads of Ministries and Departments and Non-Governmental Organizations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the Public Procurement Law based on the said Draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 500,000 pre-filled syringe of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection, 6,000IU in 0.6ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the procurement of supplying 500,000 pre-filled syringe of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection, 6,000IU in 0.6ml used for the treatment of heart patients. Four bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to M/s. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd., India, the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the High-Level Standing Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 03 CT Scanners for Nawalapitiya, Dambulla and Kuliyapitiya District Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - National competitive bids have been invited for the supply, delivery, installation, commissioning and maintenance of 03 CT Scanners (64 Slices) for Nawalapitiya, Dambulla and Kuliyapitiya District Hospitals. 04 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement for the supply of 03 CT Scanners (64 Slices) for Nawalapitiya, Dambulla and Kuliyapitiya District Hospitals to M/s Hayleys Lifesciences (Pvt.) Ltd., based on the recommendations of the High-Level Standing Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Development Project for the Nuwara Eliya Post Office Building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑04‑29 to transfer the Nuwara Eliya Post Office Building to the Urban Development Authority. There were protests from postal employees, civil organizations and the general public against the transfer. It was later decided to implement a project to renovate the said building so that it can be used for the functions of the Postal Department as before and for tourism promotion activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to revoke the Cabinet decision taken to transfer the Nuwara Eliya Post Office Building and land to the Urban Development Authority and to modernize the said building and land in order to enhance local/foreign tourist attraction and to develop new revenue generation channels, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of TB Component and HIV Component under the Global Fund to Fight Aids, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GFATM) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Global Fund to Fight Aids, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GFATM) Project has been implemented since 2002 under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media to manage, prevent and control three diseases: HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria. Since 2021, only two components - TB and HIV have been implemented under the said project. It has been identified that it would be appropriate to implement the 2025-2027 Grant Cycle to achieve the set targets and objectives of the National Strategic Plan for TB and the National Strategic Plan for HIV 2023-2027 in order to end the HIV/AIDS epidemic in Sri Lanka.  The Global Fund to Fight Aids, Tuberculosis and Malaria has agreed to provide allocation of US$ 2.97 million for the National Strategic Plan for TB and allocation of US$ 6.38 million for the National Strategic Plan for HIV/AIDS during the period from 2025‑2027. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said two projects separately by utilizing the said allocations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for paving works of Jaya Container Terminal - V Yard in the Port of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Ports Authority has planned to extend the existing Jaya Container Terminal - IV Quay Wall to accommodate two medium size container vessels and to develop the yard area behind to increase the yard capacity. The balance development work of Jaya Container Terminal - V need to be completed for full functioning of the said Terminal. Accordingly, national competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of paving work of the reclaimed yard area and connecting it to the existing yard. 09 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to award the relevant procurement to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd, based on the recommendations of the Bid Evaluation Committee and the High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 200 New Super Luxury Buses for Expressway Operations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As approximately 52% of the normal bus fleet and about 94% of the luxury bus fleet of the Sri Lanka Transport Board have exceeded their economic lifespan, there is an urgent need to introduce new buses to the bus fleet of the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB). Due to the insufficient number of buses to meet passenger demand on expressways, the Sri Lanka Transport Board currently operates 61 luxury buses owned by the private sector under profit-sharing basis. Sri Lanka Transport Board has decided to purchase 200 super luxury buses for expressways using its own funds. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to directly purchase 29 super luxury buses by depots with financial capability, and to purchase the rest of buses by making initial payments using funds of the Sri Lanka Transport Board and paying the balance through monthly installments within a period of 5 years from the income earned, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme proposed to be implemented by the Department of Export Agriculture to meet the export agricultural crop production targets
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Export Agriculture carries out the necessary development and research activities for the promotion of 14 export agricultural crops namely pepper, coffee, areca nut, cocoa, cloves, nutmeg, cardamom, vanilla, betel, lemon grass, citrus, garcinia, turmeric and ginger. Currently, these crops are spread over an area of ​​about 82,000 hectares, and approximately one million stakeholders are engaged in cultivation and industries related to export agricultural crops. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to implement the following programmes by the Department of Export Agriculture to encourage and promote stakeholders from the year 2025 and to provide Government benefits up to a maximum of 50% of the investment made by farmers and other stakeholders under the said programmes, was approved by the Cabinet:* Export Crops Area Expansion Programme* Programme to Increase the Productivity of Export Crops* Organic Export Crops Promotion Programme* Activities related to organic cultivation certification and laboratory analysis* International Fair Trade System Certification* Internationally recognized certifications applicable to organic farming* Facilitating the Post-harvest technology Programme* Nursery Development Programme* Maintaining export agricultural crop cultivation demonstration plots* Export agricultural crop projects related to the tourism industry

description: Project for the rehabilitation of Minneriya, Giritale, Galoya, Huruluwewa and Rajanganaya Irrigation Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the severe damage caused by the recent floods to several major irrigation schemes in the dry zone, severe obstacles have arisen in the release of water to the agricultural lands in those schemes. Provisions amounting to Rs 2,000 million have been allocated through the Budget proposals 2025 for the rehabilitation of the canal systems of the Galoya Scheme in the Ampara District, the Minneriya and Giritale Irrigation schemes in the Polonnaruwa District and the Huruluwewa and Rajanganaya Irrigation schemes in the Anuradhapura District, which are operating under the Department of Irrigation. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to carry out the following rehabilitation works in the above-mentioned irrigation projects utilizing the said provisions:* Repairing the Irrigation System and Drainage Canals of the Minneriya Irrigation Scheme - Rs.300 million.* Repairing the Irrigation System of the Giritale Irrigation Scheme - Rs.200 million.* Repairing the Flood damaged and broken Canal Systems of the Galoya Project - Rs.900 million.* Repairing the Irrigation System and Drainage Canals of the Huruluwewa Irrigation Scheme - Rs.300 million.* Repairing Gravity and Lift Irrigation Systems of the Rajanganaya Irrigation Scheme - Rs.300 million.

description: Construction of a New Three Storied Building for the Thurstan College, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Report submitted by the Building Experts of the University of Moratuwa has indicated that an old three-storied building at the Thurstan College, Colombo is unsuitable for student use and should be demolished. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to construct a new three-storied building in lieu of the said building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The project for the Digital transformation of the General Education in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The People's Republic of China has agreed to provide funds amounting to US$ 20 million for the implementation of a project to digitalize the general education in Sri Lanka. During the official visit of the President to China in January this year, an agreement was reached between the two parties to implement the said project expeditiously. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to provide the equipment required for 500 selected schools and a model smart classroom under the proposed project, and to establish the Network Operations Management Unit, the Studio Room and the Conference Room under the project in the 'Isurupaya' premises.

description: Ending the use of children in street begging, hawking, and in hazardous occupations including domestic work
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the Convention on the Rights of the Child, a child is defined as a person under the age of 18 years. According to the latest statistics, about 30% of the total population of the country belongs to the child population. It has been identified that some children are forced to do any kind of work for various reasons, beg in public places with either their mother or father, or become a victim of human trafficking as a "street child" and engage in begging in public places with someone other than their parents, and sell various things. Accordingly, the Cabinet, on being presented by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs the programme planned by her Ministry to strictly implement the existing legal provisions by the relevant authorities so that the use of children under the age of 16 years in begging and hawking and the employment of young children between the ages of 16-18 years in hazardous occupations including domestic work could be strictly prohibited from 2025-07-01, and to make the public aware through a comprehensive publicity programme, decided to grant its concurrence for the same.

description: Mobile Public Service Programme operated by the Ministry of Urban Development, Construction and Housing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that people living in rural areas and underserved urban areas face severe difficulties in resolving issues related to land use, obtaining building permits, inadequate housing facilities, infrastructure development and water supply services. The Ministry of Urban Development, Construction and Housing has planned to initiate and implement a mobile public service program, enabling the general public to easily obtain those services. The proposed program is expected to provide opportunity for the public to directly contact the officials of the institutions functioning under the Ministry, including the National Community Water Supply Department, the National Physical Planning Department, the Urban Development Authority, the Urban Settlement Development Authority, the National Housing Development Authority, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, the Condominium Management Authority and the Construction Industry Development Authority, to obtain solutions to the issues arising in relation to services related to the scope of the said institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to implement the proposed Mobile Public Service Program, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the new National Water Resources Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The new Government's manifesto has emphasized the need to conserve all water sources in the country, activate the Cascade system, properly study and nourish the river basins and regulate water consumption for various uses in order to ensure safe water consumption. Therefore, it has become a timely requirement to implement a Government policy that nourishes and protects all water sources in the country which provide space for the safe use of water resources for the present and future generations. Various parties have also pointed out that the currently effective National Water Resources Policy should be further revised. Accordingly, taking into account a proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, the Cabinet decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee comprising of the following Ministers to re-review the currently effective National Water Resources Policy and submit appropriate recommendations for revising the said policy, adhering to the policy of the present Government:* Hon. K.D. Lal Kantha,  Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation;* Hon. Sunil Handunneththi,  Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development;* Hon. Anura Karunathilaka,  Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing;* Hon. (Eng.) Kumara Jayakody,  Minister of Energy;and* Hon. (Dr.) Dammika Patabendi,  Minister of Environment.

description: The Special Fixed Deposit Scheme for Senior Citizens
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided to implement a Special Fixed Deposit Scheme for Senior Citizens as proposed in the Budget Speech for the year 2025. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to implement the proposed Special Fixed Deposit Scheme as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:* Implementation of this scheme for fixed deposits opened by Sri Lankan citizens aged 60 years or above during the period from 2025‑07‑01 to 2025‑12‑31.* The tenure of the fixed deposit should be 12 months (one year) and the maximum deposit value is one million rupees.* Payment of interest at the rate of 3% per annum plus the Average Weighted Fixed Deposit Interest Rate (AWFDR) or the rate of interest at the fixed deposit rate of the relevant bank plus 3%, whichever is higher.* Allocation of Rs.30 billion for the payment of interest subsidy for the entire programme.

description: Repealing of the Presidents' Entitlements Act, No.4 of 1986 and the Parliamentary Pensions Law, No.1 of 1977
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the policy statement "A thriving nation - A beautiful life" presented to the public by the current Government, the people have given the Government a mandate to abolish the special privileges granted to former Presidents and their families and to abolish the pension granted to Members of Parliament after 05 years. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare 02 Bills to repeal the Presidents' Entitlements Act, No.4 of 1986 and the Parliamentary Pensions Law, No.1 of 1977 enabling to abolish the special privileges granted to former Presidents and their families and to abolish the pension of Members of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining additional provisions for the future construction work of Amaradeva Aesthetic and Research Centre (Amaradeva Asapuwa)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A plot of land with an extent of 100-perches has been allocated in the Battaramulla Apegama premises for the construction of the Amaradeva Aesthetic and Research Centre (Amaradeva Asapuwa). The Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, the consultancy firm, has estimated that Rs.21.745 million is required to complete the remaining works of the second phase of the Amaradeva Asapuwa and another Rs.179.436 million is required to complete the final phase. It has also been indicated that another Rs.20 million is required to purchase essential items to maintain office operations after the completion of the work. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to allocate the necessary provisions to complete the construction work of the Amaradeva Asapuwa and maintain the office operations thereon, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Universities Act, No.16 of 1978, was last amended by the Universities (Amendment) Act, No.17 of 2016 and it has been observed that the problems arise due to ambiguities in certain provisions of the Act in the selection and appointment of persons to various administrative positions. Accordingly, the need has been identified to amend the qualifications proposed for appointment to the post of Dean of a Faculty under sub-section (1) of section 49 of the said Act and the qualifications for appointment as a Head of Academic Division under sub‑section (1) of section 51 of the said Act. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the said Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Protection of Rights of Elders Act, No. 9 of 2000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the mid-year annual population estimate 2024, the elderly community in Sri Lanka is about 2.7 million. The United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs has predicted that the elderly population of Sri Lanka aged 60 years or above will increase up to 24.8% by the year 2052. Therefore, under the Government National Policy Framework of "A thriving nation - A beautiful life", the Government has drawn special attention to providing the necessary infrastructure facilities to live a socially, economically, physically and spiritually satisfying life for the aging adults, enabling to achieve the objective of "A respectable senior citizen - A meaningful retirement". For this purpose, the necessity of amending the Protection of the Rights of Elders Act, No.9 of 2000  catering to the current needs has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the said Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau of Sri Lanka (AAIBSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka Act, No.34 of 2002, the Authority is entrusted with the responsibility of investigating Aircraft accidents and incidents within the purview of Sri Lanka. However, findings at the Safety Oversight Audit of the International Civil Aviation Organization conducted in the year 2010, have revealed information on the absence of an independent process in the country for conducting investigations on Aircraft accidents and incidents. Accordingly, the Cabinet approval has been granted for the establishment of the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau of Sri Lanka as an independent institution in the year 2016 and a Bill had been prepared by the Legal Draftsman for this purpose. The relevant parties have indicated that several further provisions should be introduced for the said Bill. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to prepare the relevant Bill incorporating the said provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Public Commercial Business Management Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-04-28 to introduce a new Act titled Public Commercial Business Management Act to operate the state-owned business entities with a sound management and by introducing necessary reforms and to appoint a Cabinet Committee to review the initial draft prepared for drafting the said new Act, make appropriate amendments and further improve the said draft. The said Cabinet Committee has reviewed the initial draft and submitted the Committee Report containing its recommendations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the Public Commercial Business Management Bill, based on the recommendations of that Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Trusted Digital Repository at the National Archives (Phase 01)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑04‑05 granted approval to implement the Trusted Digital Repository at the National Archives Phase-01 Project. Through the proposed project, it is expected to install software essential for the preservation of information and providing access thereto, which is the primary function of the National Archives. The International Archival Council has agreed to provide a grant of Euro 7,000 to the National Archives through a fund of the said Council and it has been planned to utilize this amount to cover a portion of the cost of the proposed project. The implementation of the proposed project will enable the National Archives to provide its services to the general public more effectively and efficiently. Accordingly, the  proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to implement the proposed project for establishing a Trusted Digital Repository within the period from 2025-2027, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Concrete Waste Recycling Project to be implemented by the State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka has proposed to implement a pilot project for recycling concrete and construction waste. Elements obtained through the recycling of concrete and construction waste under this project have been planned to be utilized in the production of suitable products and combined with raw materials sourced directly from natural resources. The machinery of the proposed project has been identified as suitable for installation at the precast concrete yard of the Ekala Industrial Estate of the State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to implement the proposed Project by utilizing the provisions of Rs.200 million allocated to the Ministry under the "Clean Sri Lanka" programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 26th Session of the Intergovernmental Group (IGG) on Tea of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations, 4th Annual Meeting of the Asian Tea Alliance (ATA) and the Centenary Celebration of the Tea Research Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The proposals submitted by the Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure to conduct the 26th Session of the Intergovernmental Group on Tea of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, 4th Annual Meeting of the Asian Tea Alliance and the Centenary Celebration of the Tea Research Institute, from 9th to 14th November 2025, in Colombo and take necessary action relating to the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 20 Prime Movers for the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 119 Diesel-Powered Prime Movers and Terminal Tractors are used for container operations in Terminals of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority and for Inter Terminal Container Transportation within the port premises. Out of them, 60 vehicles are over 20 years old and require frequent repairs. Considering this situation, the Board of Directors of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority decided in the year 2023 to purchase 20 terminal tractors, for which prior approval of the Cabinet of Ministers has been granted. Subsequently, according to the updated requirements of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, the Board of Directors of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority has decided to purchase 20 Electric Prime Movers instead of the previously proposed Diesel-powered Terminal Tractors. Rs. 1,000 million has been allocated under the Capital Budget of the said Authority for the year 2025/2026 for this purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to implement the procurement for the purchase of the said 20 Prime Movers through the International Competitive Bidding Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 07 Nos. of Gantry cranes for Container Handling at the East Container Terminal and the Jaya Container Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Ports Authority has made provisions under the budget 2025 for the procurement of 07 nos of electric rubber-tyre gantry cranes for container operations at the East Container Terminal and the Jaya Container Terminal of the said Authority. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to procure 07 gantry cranes, following the international competitive bidding procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The programme to protect the boundaries and conservation areas of selected major tanks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to various activities such as urbanization, expansion of settlements and establishment of new industries taking place in the lands located near the tanks, there is a tendency for various land use patterns to spread in those areas. Due to changes in land use patterns, it has been identified as a timely need to clearly demarcate the boundaries of the main tanks which are already subject to various impacts and are likely to be subject to such impacts, using official boundary markers of the Department of Irrigation, so that any citizen or party can easily recognize such boundaries. In addition, it has been further identified that it is appropriate to plant suitable trees between the boundaries and form a bio-fence. For this purpose, it is expected that the Survey Department, the Department of Wildlife Conservation, the Department of Forest Conservation, relevant Divisional Secretaries, Farmer Organizations, Environmental Organizations, Social Organizations and school children will be appropriately involved. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to implement the proposed programme using the provisions of Rs.100 million provided to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation under the "Clean Sri Lanka" project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the services of the Department of Meteorology under the Climate Resilience Multi-Phase Programmatic Approach (CResMPA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation is implementing the Climate Resilience Multi-Phase Programmatic Approach with financial support from the World Bank.  Modernizing the weather and climate-related services of the Department of Meteorology to reduce climate-related disaster risks through accurate early warnings and to support national development has been identified as a priority task under Component 1 of the first phase of the project. Accordingly, Expressions of Interest have been invited following the World Bank Procurement Guidelines to select a consultancy firm to carry out the modernization of the services of the Department of Meteorology. 08 institutions have submitted Expressions of Interest for this purpose. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to award the relevant consultancy services contract, to the Asian Disaster Preparedness Centre in Bangkok, Thailand, based on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee.

description: Preparation of the Watershed Management Plan for the Kelani River Basin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The watersheds of the Kelani River Basin are currently facing major environmental problems due to severe degradation of the catchment areas, sedimentation in the low-lying regions, sand mining, changing land use patterns, urbanization, industrialization, pollution of catchment areas and deterioration of the water quality. Considering these factors, the necessity of preparing a Watershed Management Plan for the Kelani River, including sub-watershed level management plan with sufficient simplicity and critical details has been identified. There is a possibility of implementing the plan in collaboration with the relevant institutions and the people living in catchment areas to restore the watersheds. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, the Cabinet approved to formulate a Watershed Management Plan for the Kelani River Basin during the years 2025 and 2026, utilizing the provisions of Rs.250 million allocated under the "Clean Sri Lanka" program, and implement the same within the medium-term budgetary framework.

description: Obtaining additional finance from the World Bank for the General Education 	and Modernization Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The General Education Modernization (GEM) Project has been operational since 2018 under funds of US$100 million provided by the World Bank. As of now, almost all project components identified under this Project have been implemented and desired outcomes have been achieved. It has been found that there is a possibility of securing an additional financial facility of US$50 million from remaining funds under other projects to implement several other components identified under this project. This additional financial facility is expected to be utilized for improving digital infrastructure in schools, improving sanitation facilities in 900 selected schools across all provinces, implementing reformed curriculum assessment and teacher professional development programmes in relation to the implementation of the new education reforms to be initiated in 2026. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to conduct negotiations with the World Bank to obtain the proposed additional financing, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for providing a cost of living allowance for children in institutional care or guardianship and street children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Institutional care is provided in Detention Homes/Child Development Centers for children who do not have proper care and protection in the home they live in, due to the loss of parents, loss of custody, or even under the custody of both the mother and father or one of them and also to orphaned and abandoned children. It has been reported that by the end of the year 2024, about 9,191 children are receiving residential care in 356 Child Development Centers run by the Government, voluntary organizations and Non-governmental organizations throughout the country. A provision of Rs. 1,000 million has been allocated through the Budget for the year 2025 to provide a monthly allowance of Rs. 5,000/- for children under institutional care and guardianship and street children. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Woman and Child Affairs to pay the proposed cost of living allowance as follows and to appoint a National Steering Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs and comprising officers from other relevant institutions, to provide necessary guidance and review activities for the sustainable and effective implementation of the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.* providing a sum of Rs.3,000/- from the cost of living allowance of Rs.5,000/- to the Development Center where the child is staying or to the guardian through the National Savings Bank for the education, health and other welfare expenses to be provided under the guardianship.* depositing the remaining sum of Rs.2,000/- monthly in a savings account in the National Savings Bank in favour of the child for the future well-being of the child.

description: Formulation of a National Policy for the Rehabilitation of Child Offenders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Primary objective of the child rehabilitation process is to identify the misbehavior of a child who is convicted before the law and to enable him/her to live as a law-abiding citizen of the society. Accordingly, when taking action against a child who is convicted before the law, mediation, admonition and release, conditional release, probation for child offenders who can be rehabilitated in an open environment, rehabilitation under the Community Corrections Service and detention in detention centres are carried out depending on the nature of the offense. It has been identified that the rehabilitation of such children should be carried out according to an accepted national policy after studying the economic and social background of the children who are convicted before the law and their families. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to draft the "National Policy for the Rehabilitation of Child Offenders" with the contribution of the Government, development partners and institutions such as the United Nations International Children's Fund (UNICEF), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Investment Proposals for a plot of land owned by the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to invite investment proposals for the plot of land in extent of 03 roods and 13.85 perches owned by the Urban Development Authority, located at No. 40, D.R. Wijewardena Mawatha, Colombo 10 and select a suitable investor to develop the land. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of  Urban Development, Construction and Housing to invite investment proposals to dispose the said plot of land on a 99-year lease basis, based on the updated valuation of the Chief Government Valuer for the purpose of selecting a suitable investor to implement a Mixed Development Project in the relevant land in accordance with the Urban Development Regulations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: An Act to amend the Penal Code (Corporal Punishment) (Chapter 19)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been scientifically proven that physical and psychological abuse caused to a child by corporal punishment is extensive. Therefore, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-04-29 to amend the Penal Code (Chapter 19) to prohibit the corporal punishment in all spheres and to make provisions for the imposition of punishment for physical abuse. Although the Cabinet of Ministers has previously granted approval to publish the Penal Code (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman for the relevant purpose, in the Government Gazette and present the same in Parliament, it has not been possible to act accordingly. The need for the expeditious enactment of the said Bill has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter to submit the same to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979 (Corporal Punishment)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-04-29 to  amend the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No. 15 of 1979 to make provisions for the prohibition of Corporal Punishment in all spheres. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to grant policy approval of the present Cabinet to prepare an amending Bill for the relevant purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of the 'Promotion of Breastfeeding' Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka ranks among the highest in the world in terms of breastfeeding indicators and has become the first country to be awarded ‘Green Status’ by the World Breastfeeding Trends initiative (WBTi). Approval has been granted by the Cabinet of Ministers on 2018-10-16 to introduce legal provisions through an Act to promote breastfeeding, with the aim of protecting the health and nutrition of children by protecting children from the unethical and harmful effects of the milk powder industry on children for commercial purposes,, protecting breastfeeding as a key intervention that is scientifically proven, and ensuring that the country continues to be recognized as a global leader in breastfeeding. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to grant policy approval of the present Cabinet for the preparation of the relevant Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of an Act for the establishment of the Matara Cultural and Development Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Matara has been identified as a city with significant historical, cultural and natural and tourist potential which needs to be conserved and developed for economic and employment benefits of Sri Lankan citizens. Nevertheless, it is observed that these potentials remain underutilized. Accordingly, it has been identified that it is essential to formulate an Act pertaining to the Matara heritage  and development to achieve the expectations of developing the Matara City, sustainably conserving its heritage and modernizing the city. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism; Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing; and the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs, to prepare a Bill related to Matara Heritage and Development for Matara city, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (SLIA) Law No.1 of 1976
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Institute of Architects, the sole body established in Sri Lanka for the profession of Architecture, its practice and education of Architecture has been incorporated by the provisions of the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects Law, No. 1 of 1976, amended by the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (Amendment) Act, No. 14 of 1996. In order to cope with the current context of professional practices, the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects has proposed to amend the relevant sections of the Principal Act, “Practice in Architecture and Membership and Use of Titles”. Accordingly, approval has been granted by the Cabinet of Ministers on 2023-04-17 to prepare a Bill for the relevant purpose. As per the said approval, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to grant policy approval of the present Cabinet of Ministers to complete the preparation of the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (Amendment) Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new residential building at the Treatment and Rehabilitation Centre for young people with drug addiction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Dangerous Drugs Control Board conducts treatment and rehabilitation services for people with drug addiction, under residential and    non-residential community-based models. Under this, a dedicated treatment centre for children and young people below 21 years of age with disabilities arising from drug use disorders is being maintained at Mampitiya Watta, Handessa, Peradeniya. It has been identified that separate treatment services and adequate separate space are essential for the treatment of the relevant persons, paying attention to the psycho-social characteristics of the persons belonging to that age group and their drug use related behaviors. Since the current residential capacity of the relevant Centre is only for 35 persons, it is necessary to maintain a waiting list for admissions. Therefore, the  proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to construct a new residential building in the premises of the Peradeniya Treatment Centre, spending Rs.110 million from the provisions allocated under the Clean Sri Lanka Programme, enabling to expand and expedite treatment opportunities for children and young people with drug addiction, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Waste Compactor Vehicles for regularizing transport of Waste in Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Like many developing countries, solid waste management in Sri Lanka is currently facing many challenges and difficulties. Accordingly, the need to improve the infrastructure required for municipal waste management has been identified. The existing garbage compactors and tractors are used to transport the collected municipal waste in an environmental friendly manner to the treatment sites so as to minimize public impact, and 100 compactors were purchased in the year 2017 using domestic funds for the said purpose. However, it has been observed that the number of such vehicles and the number of vehicles including tractors owned by the Local Authorities are not adequate to manage the amount of waste currently generated. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to purchase 16 waste compactor vehicles to streamline the collection and transportation of waste in the selected Local Authorities, utilizing the budgetary provisions of Rs. 500 million allocated for the year 2025 under the Clean Sri Lanka Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving and maintaining the broadcasting activities of the Independent Television Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Independent Television Network, which was started as the first television channel in the country, operates as a company with 100% share rights owned by the General Treasury. However, due to the fact that programmes have to be produced using computer accessories and outdated software that are several years old, it has become problematic to broadcast high-quality, attractive programmes while competing in the field. Therefore, taking into account a proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media, the Cabinet decided to allocate the required provisions through the 2026 Budget on a priority basis to secure several essential  accessories for the Independent Television Network, enabling to enhance subscriber attraction and continue telecasting activities without interruption.

description: Allocation of provisions for the projects identified in the industrial and enterprise development sectors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Policy and other decisions required to uplift the existing status of the Small Enterprises Development Division, Industrial Development Board, Lanka Salusala Ltd, Ceylon Ceramics Corporation and the Export Development Board are being implemented with the intervention of those Institutions/divisions and the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development utilizing the staff, natural resources, machinery and other physical resources of those institutions/divisions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to allocate Rs. 100 million from the provisions allocated for the year 2025 under the Sectoral Development Programme of the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development for the following projects was approved by the Cabinet.* Reality Show Programme organized by the Small Enterprises Development Division.* Industry Expo Exhibition organized by Industrial Development Board.* Pilot project to establish a revolving fund to provide raw materials required for local textile production at subsidized prices.* Providing working capital to the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation.* Purchase of scanners to introduce Advanced Scanner Technology to the inspection yard (Security Checkpoint at Cargo Village) maintained  by the Industrial Development Board at the premises of Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake.

description: Preparation of the Master Plan for the Bandaranaike International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Proposals have been invited through the International Competitive Bidding Procedure to select a consultancy firm to prepare the master plan for the Bandaranaike International Airport. After evaluating the said proposals,  Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited has cancelled the relevant contract due to non-adherence to the conditions of the contract by the company that was awarded the contract and resumed the procurement process on the approval of the Cabinet. For the procurement newly invited, only M/s Haskoning DHV Netherland B.V., operating as Netherlands Airport Consultants, has submitted a single proposal. The Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee, having evaluated the said proposal has recommended that the relevant consultancy contract be awarded to the above firm. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said procurement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Section IV (from Kurunegala to Dambulla) of the Central 	Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-03-20 to pay the remaining compensation for land plots acquired for Section IV of the Central Expressway Project (Kurunegala - Dambulla) and for which partial compensation had been paid and to divest land plots for which compensation had not been paid in accordance with the Land Acquisition Act. The physical progress of the land acquisition process for Section IV of the Central Expressway Project is 73.2%. It has been identified that completion of  Section IV of the  Central Expressway is essential to meet the need for a quantitative and qualitative road system to access to the Northern, North Central, Eastern and Central Provinces, and to obtain the expected full benefits of the entire Central Expressway. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to resume the currently suspended land acquisition activities for the future construction work related to the Kurunegala to Dambulla Section of the Central Expressway Project - Section IV, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Faculty of Medicine of the Uva Wellassa University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-06-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Faculty of Medicine of the Uva Wellassa University has been established in accordance with a budget proposal for the year 2023.
