decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2022-09-05 to publish the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to introduce the Anti‑Terrorism Act by repealing the Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act in the Government Gazette and thereafter present it in the Parliament according to which the said Bill was published in the Government Gazette on 2023-03-22. Subsequently, several interested parties (local and International) have submitted their views on certain sections of the Bill. Accordingly, the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has formally invited opinions and suggestions from the interested parties through electronic and electronic media, and the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has held discussions with some parties. Hence, taking into consideration all the opinions and suggestions that have been submitted, necessary action has been taken to    re-revise the original Bill published in the Government Gazette and prepare a fresh Bill through the Legal Draftsman. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said fresh Bill.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Online Safety Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body:
- The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Online Safety Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman with the objective of protecting the civil society from damages caused by online falsehoods and manipulation. The following actions have been interpreted as offenses through the provisions of this Act, as indicated in the Part III of the Bill.

*	Communication of false statements of facts in Sri Lanka

*	Making false statements amounting to contempt

*	Wantongly giving provocation by false statement to cause riot

*	Disturbing a religious assembly by a false statement

*	Communicating a false statement with deliberate intent to wound religious feelings

*	Deliberate and malicious communication of false statement to outrage religious feelings

*	Cheating

*	Cheating by personation
*	Intentional insult by false statement with intent to provoke a breach of peace

*	Circulating false report with intent to cause mutiny or an offence against the state etc.

*	Communicating statements of fact to cause harassment.

*	Child abuse

*	Making or altering bots to commit an offence
  
Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Promotion of Export Agriculture Act, No.46 of 1992
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of amending the Promotion of Export Agriculture Act, No.46 of 1992 in keeping up with the current needs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the said Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repeal of the Rent Act, No.7 of 1972 and introduction of the Protection of Occupants Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - Even though the Rent Act, No.7 of 1972 which was introduced with the objective of determining the rights and the duties of landlords and tenants, was amended at several occasions, it is observed that the intended objectives of the Act are not being met. The Advisory Committee on Rent Law set up under the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has examined the matters with this regard and has proposed that it would be appropriate to introduce a new law with the aim of safeguarding the rights of the landlord and the tenant equally. Taking	these proposals into consideration, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to repeal the Rent Act, No.7 of 1972 and to introduce a fresh Act namely, the Protection of Occupants Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making provisions for the registration of electric-powered motor tricycles 	(Three-wheelers)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that in the production of electric-powered motor tricycles and in the conversion of motor tricycles powered by petrol or diesel into electric motor tricycles, the tare weight of such tricycles may exceed 500 kilograms since electric-charged batteries are used for that. Also, according to the interpretation of the Motor Traffic Act, the tare weight of a motor tricycle must not exceed 500kg and the gross weight must not exceed 1000kg. Accordingly, the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑08‑08 has granted approval to amend the Motor Traffic Act by removing prevailing impediments to register electric-powered tricycles. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman as per the said approval. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy and Action Plan on Migration for Employment Sri Lanka 	2023 - 2027
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - The first policy of Sri Lanka on labor migration has been formulated in the year 2008 as the National Labor Migration Policy.  The said Policy has been reviewed by obtaining views of all stakeholders in the labor migration sector including relevant Ministries, migrant workers and their family members, foreign employment agencies, private sector, civil society organizations, trade unions, academia, research institutions and development partners, international non-governmental organizations and United Nations Agencies and the National Policy and Action Plan on Migration for Employment Sri Lanka 2023 - 2027 has been drafted. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to implement the said Policy and Action Plan 2023‑2027 formulated in accordance with the national and international legal and policy frameworks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations by the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka with the Union of the Comoros and the Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - The African region consists of 54 sovereign States recognized by the United Nations. Out of which, Sri Lanka has established diplomatic relations with 46 countries and is awaiting concurrence from 6 more countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to establish diplomatic relations with the Union of the Comoros consisting of a group of islands situated in the Eastern Africa of the African Region and the São Tomé and Príncipe, an African island located in Gulf of Guinea, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting a plot of land located at D.M. Colombage Mawatha, Kirulapone to the Warakagoda Sri Gnanarathana Social Welfare Foundation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - A request has been made by the Mahanayaka Thero of Kandy Asgiri Maha Viharaya to provide a plot of land suitable for construction of a designated monastery in order to provide accommodation facilities to monks visiting from distant regions for the national and religious events held in Colombo and its suburbs and for other requirements as well. A block of land in extent of 27 perches owned by the Urban Development Authority located at D.M. Colombage Mawatha, Kirulapana has been identified for that purpose and the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to vest the said block of land with the Warakagoda Sri Gnanarathana Social Welfare Foundation through a free grant, for the construction of a monastery, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Leasing out of the servient right of several land lots located in Muthurajawela owned by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, for laying of an underground pipeline system of the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - A land in extent of 69-acres in Muthurajawela owned by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, was set apart by means of selling to the Ceylon Electricity Board in 1997, and the Yugadanavi Power Plant has been built in a potion of the said land. The new Sobadhanavi power plant is currently being built in the remaining portion of the said land. The need for the construction of underground cooling pipelines and underground fuel pipelines for those fuel plants have been identified. For that purpose, several other plots of land in Muthurajawela owned by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation have been identified, and accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to lease out the servient right of those plots along with the right to sub-lease, to the Ceylon Electricity Board on lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion of Tertiary Education through Vocational Guidance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - A program has been designed to provide opportunities for the students who complete G.E.C. (O/L) until they start studies for G.E.C. (A/L) or those who complete the G.E.C. (A/L) examination until they embark upon vocational Education, to complete a curriculum that covers five basic areas related to vocational education while retaining them within the school system. The program is mainly expected to develop Information Technology and English language which are generally important for professional education and also develop soft skills in parallel with the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the said project as a pilot project for a period of 3-4 months in 320 selected schools covering every educational division of the Island, and thereafter to implement the said programme as a national programme from the year 2024 onwards based on the results of the pilot programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The progress of the Mega Scale Development Projects at the end of the 	Second Quarter of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet considered the report submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies on the progress achieved by 202 mega scale development projects implemented by line Ministries by the end of the second quarter of 2023. Cabinet noted that, the progress of the most of the projects is below the expected level by the end of the second quarter of 2023 owing to the fact that the funds related to the projects implemented on foreign funds cannot be used until the debt restructuring process that has been started is completed, and the release of domestic funds is limited. Accordingly, Cabinet decided to allocate provisions in the year 2024, giving priority to the projects that can contribute to achieve the Government's 2048 development goals and as a solution to the current economic crisis, until it becomes possible to use foreign funds after completion of the debt restructuring process.

description: Working under an Integrated approach treating the need for water management as an emergency situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
decision_details_body: - A report released on 2023‑08‑22 by the National Disaster Relief Centre has shown that owing to the prevailed dry weather condition, around 84,000 families in 70 divisional secretariat divisions belonging to 17 districts of the Island have to face a shortage of drinking water. Under that backdrop, the existing limited water capacities should be utilized and managed in an optimal manner until an adequate capacity of water is collected in the reservoir systems in the country. According to the National Water Resources Policy approved by the Cabinet on 2023‑07‑10, priority should be given to providing drinking water, and the government is also committed to protect other water stakeholders. Accordingly, the proposals stated in the joint Cabinet Memorandum submitted by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government; the Minister of Irrigation and the Minister of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development to treat the supply of drinking water as an urgent and priority requirement until there is a sufficient rainfall and to function the National Water Resources Council proposed by the National Water Resources Policy as an Urgent Action Committee in order to take necessary action for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for Ground Handling Services for SriLankan Airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body:
- Limited International Competitive Bids have been invited for ground handling services for SriLankan Airlines at Delhi and Trichy International Airports in India, Beijing International Airport in China and Kuwait International Airport. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the relevant procurements respectively to the following bidders as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Celebi Airport Services India Pvt. Ltd.

*	Bird Airport Services (Trichy) Pvt. Ltd.

*	Beijing Aviation Ground Services Company Limited 

*	National Aviation Services W.L.L.

description: Awarding the contract for supplying of Aviation Fuel for SriLankan Airlines at 	London Heathrow Airport, United Kingdom and Changi Airport, Singapore
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - Limited International Competitive Bids have been invited to secure fuel for SriLankan Airlines at London Heathrow Airport, United Kingdom and Changi Airport, Singapore which have been received 3 bids. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the contracts to secure fuel for SriLankan Airlines at the above airports, to Shell Markets (Middle East) Limited, the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repatriation of six artifacts belonging to Kandyan Era which were taken to Netherlands two centuries ago
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-06-26 to conduct the required negotiations to repatriate the six artifacts belonging to Kandyan Era which were taken to Netherlands two centuries ago, to Sri Lanka. Accordingly, after negotiations, the Government of Netherlands have declared by a Government Gazette Notification that they are taking measures to return the said six artifacts to Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to sign a legal document of Acknowledgment of Transference between the two parties for return of the said artifacts and an Agreement to retain these artifacts in the Rijks Museum in Netherlands until they are physically brought to Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Anti-Terrorism Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-02-27 to publish the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to introduce the Anti-Terrorism Act by repealing the Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act, No.48 of 1979 currently in force, in the Government Gazette. It has been decided to introduce required amendments for the said Bill, taking into consideration the views expressed by several interested parties on some of the sections in the said Bill published in the Government Gazette.   Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to re-prepare the Anti-Terrorism Bill incorporating the amendments identified in the Bill already drafted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the approval of the Parliament for the Regulations promulgated under the Forest Conservation Ordinance No.16 of 1907 (Chapter 451)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation to submit the Export of timber, seeds of forest free species or other forest produce Regulations No.01 of 2023, made under the Forest Conservation Ordinance No.16 of 1907 (Chapter 451), published in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No.2346/02 dated 2023-08-21 in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Simplification of the Existing Visa process of the Department of	Immigration	and Emigration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Department of Immigration and Emigration issues 3 types of Visa as Visit Visa, Residence Visa and Transit Visa to the foreigners who visit Sri Lanka in accordance with the Immigrants and Emigrants Act, No.20 of 1948 and its regulations. Taking into consideration the complexities of the Visa categories issued under 2 types of Visa; the Visit Visa and the Residence Visa and by exploring the Visa procedure implemented in the countries with greater tourist attractions, steps had been taken to re-review the visa process of the country. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Minister of Public Security to Simplify the existing visa processes further, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement related to the implementation of Private-Public Partnership Project for deploying Electric Buses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑02‑27 has granted approval to procure 50 electric buses as a Public-Private Partnership Project to run on behalf of the Sri Lanka Transport Board covering the Western Province. Nevertheless, it has been identified that it would be more appropriate to increase the number of electric buses deployed under the proposed project up to 200 enabling to provide public transport facilities for a larger number of roads by ensuring the expected benefits of the said Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to increase the number of electric buses up to 200 to be procured under the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Import of eggs required for providing to consumers at a reasonable price
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been previously granted to import eggs and release them to the domestic market through the State Trading (General) Corporation with a view to stabilizing the price of eggs in the domestic market. Accordingly, bids have been invited from 03 companies in India recommended by the Department of Animal Production and Health. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to procure a quantity of 92.1 million of eggs through the State Trading (General) Corporation for a period of 03 months based on the said prices and taking into consideration the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Office for National Unity and Reconciliation Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑01‑23 has granted approval to draft the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation Bill. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly.  As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations made under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021 in Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to submit the following Regulations issued by the Minister of Investment Promotion under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Colombo Port City (Development Control) Regulations No.1 of 2023 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2334/47 dated 2023‑06‑02.

*	Colombo Port City (Authorised Persons Engaged in Business) Regulations No.1 of 2023 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2339/31 dated 2023‑07‑07.

description: Submission of Regulations under section 107A of the Customs Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑08‑01 has granted approval to encourage  migrant workers to send their remittances through legal channels. Accordingly, the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has published in the Government Gazette, the "Passengers' Baggage (Exemption - Inward) Regulations No.01 of 2023" under section 107A of the Customs Ordinance  in order to give effect to the incentives awarded by the Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said Regulations issued in terms of the provisions of the Customs Ordinance, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Orders published in the Gazette to Parliament for 	approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - 	The Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has published through the Government Gazette, 03 Orders to revise the Customs Import Duty under the under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 and 04 Orders under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 in the process of implementation of the Government policy decisions to stabilize the market price of essential food items and facilitate local farmers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said Orders to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-06-05 for the amendment of the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002 and to abolish the Simplified Value Added Tax System with effect from 2024-01-01. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman.  The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing an uninterrupted supply of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) from January 2024 onwards - Litro Gas Lanka Ltd
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Term Contract for the supply of 280,000 MT of LPG to Litro Gas Lanka Ltd. is scheduled to expire on 2023‑12‑31 and bids have now been invited for the supply of LPG for the period of 2024-2025. However, since the restructuring process of Litro Gas Lanka Ltd. has been commenced now, it has been found that entering into new Agreements may adversely affect the said restructuring process. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to take necessary action to purchase 50% from the total supply of the existing Term Contract from the present supplier as a repeat order as per the provisions of the Government Procurement Guidelines to secure uninterrupted supply of LPG, until the restructuring process is completed after 2023‑12‑31, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka's hosting of the 23rd Council of Ministers meeting of the Indian	Ocean Rim Association
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Indian Ocean Rim Association was initiated in 1995 and consists of 23member countries at present. It has been planned to conduct the 25th Committee of Senior Officials Meeting of this Association on 2023‑10‑09 and 2023‑10‑10, and the 23rd Meeting of the Council of Ministers on 2023‑10‑11 in Colombo. Sri Lanka will assume the Chair of the Indian Ocean Rim Association from 2023 to 2025 at the upcoming Council of Ministers meeting and during the said period the theme was selected as ''Strengthening the Regional base: Empowering the identity of Indian Ocean''.The above information presented by the Minister of Foreign Affairs was considered by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding for the Technical 	Cooperation between the Ceylon Electricity Board and the Japan 	Electric Power Information Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Electricity Board has been cooperating with the Japan Electric Power Information Centre since 2018 and a technical cooperation programme has also been implemented in 2019. Both parties have agreed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to implement a technical cooperation programme from the year 2023 so that they can engage in multiple knowledge sharing programmes, based on the cooperation so created. The draft Memorandum of Understanding on the proposed technical cooperation for the purpose has been prepared in accordance with the observations of the Attorney General and the Minister of Foreign Affairs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocating a plot of land located in Dambulla belonging to the Urban	Development Authority for an Agro-Based Logistics and Industry Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2020‑10‑19 to call for investment proposals from the investors of the private sector on competitive basis to develop the lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority.  As per a proposal so received, the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee of the Ministry of Urban Development and Housing has approved to grant a land in extent of 03 Roods and 17.75 perches at the Dambulla divisional secretariat division belonging to the Urban Development Authority on lease basis, to implement an Agro-Based Logistics and Industry Project. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to grant the said land on lease basis, to Dambulla Agro Cool Holdings (Pvt) Ltd., for a period of 30 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting deeds to the doctors in the Wedagama Village of Indigenous medical practitioners
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Wedagama model village has been set up in the Dompe Divisional Secretariat Division in order to appreciate services of Indigenous Medical Practitioners, promote indigenous medicine and enable to obtain the services of Indigenous Medical Practitioners skilled in different areas at the same location. In the said village, 25 Indigenous Medical Practitioners each have been allocated approximately one acre of land, but so far, the Titles of such lands have not been transferred to them. The availability of a freehold deed for these lands in the name of the Secretary, Ministry of Health and Indigenous Medicine has become a major impediment to transfer the ownership of such lands to Indigenous Medicinal Practitioners. The Attorney General has given instructions on the steps to be taken regarding the transfer of the respective lands to the Indigenous Medicinal Practitioners, and accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Health to take necessary action to offer formal grants for such lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for Supplying of Aviation Fuel for SriLankan Airlines at the Hamad International Airport Doha, Qatar and the Kuwait International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - Existing Aviation Fuel Supply Contracts for SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Hamad International Airport Doha, Qatar and the Kuwait International Airport are due to expire on 2023‑10‑31.  Bids have been invited from Qatar Fuel Company and Kuwait Aviation Fueling Company, sole aviation fuel suppliers at the said 02 Airports, in accordance with the Government Procurement Guidelines. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the contracts for fuel suppliers for aircraft of SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Hamad International Airport Doha, Qatar and and the Kuwait International Airport for a period of 24 months as direct contracts, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the Public Pilgrimage Hall constructed under the Kataragama Pooja Bhoomi Planning Scheme with the Kiri Vehera Raja Maha Viharaya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - Public Pilgrimage Hall constructed under the Kataragama Pooja Bhoomi Planning Scheme has been vested with the Kiri Vehera Raja Maha Viharaya for a period of 05 years for maintenance and continuance and it returned to the National Physical Planning Department after the expiry of the said time period. The Chief Incumbent Thero of the Kataragama Raja Maha Viharaya has made a request to vest the said Pilgrimage Hall again with the Kiri Vehera Raja Maha Viharaya. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to vest the said Pilgrimage Hall with the  Kataragama Raja Maha Viharaya for a period 05 years upon a Memorandum of Understanding, subject to carrying out the maintenance, renovations and settlement of bills relating to contractual services of the building by the said Viharaya, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - An agreement has been reached during the discussions held with the relevant parties to lift import restrictions on number of other goods where importation has been temporarily suspended through the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 02 of 2023 through which import restrictions were imposed, while further continuing import restrictions on passenger motor vehicles and certain selected goods.  The Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 11 of 2023 have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2341/38 dated 2023‑07‑20 by making provisions for the above purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to present the said Regulations to Parliament for approval as per the provisions of the the Imports and Exports (Control) Act No. 1 of 1969, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a new Department for Cinnamon Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the contribution of cinnamon to foreign exchange earnings as a minor export crop, the Hon. President has pointed out the necessity of promoting the said crop as a commercial crop, through a Budget proposal for the year 2023. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Plantation Industries to establish a new Department named as the Cinnamon Development Department to provide the necessary facilities for the production and exportation of cinnamon, improvement of the quality of cinnamon products, value addition, diversification of products and facilitate  cinnamon growers, processors and exporters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Productivity Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - It is necessary to develop the productivity of all sectors of the economy in order to bring the benefits achieved by the reforms implemented with the aim to mitigate the impact of the current economic crisis to a maximum level and to ensure the medium and long-term sustainability of those reforms. However, there is no legally responsible institution in this country to address the issues related to productivity. Therefore, it has been identified the necessity of the establishment of the National Productivity Commission as an independent body to look into the issues related to productivity and recommend to the government on policy directions based on research-based evidence and data. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to appoint an Experts Committee to determine the organizational structure of the proposed National Productivity Commission, compilation of required legislation for the establishment of the said Commission and to study the other matters that need to be addressed in relation to the establishment of the said Commission, and submit a Report to the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enforcement of Bilateral and Multilateral Agreements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - It has been decided at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-05-22, that after entering into bilateral and multilateral agreements which are determined to be essential for national development, laws should be enacted incorporating the provisions, so as not to deviate from those agreements without the consent of the parties concerned. The proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill based on the preliminary draft that has been prepared accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Guidelines prepared as per the provisions of the Office on the Missing 	Persons Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions mentioned in section 11(c) of the Office on the Missing Persons (Establishment, Administration and Discharge of Functions) Act No.14 of 2016, the rules and guidelines should be issued from time to time incorporating the policies to be followed relating to excise and discharge of powers, duties and functions of the that Office. Accordingly,  the relevant Guidelines have been prepared considering the observations and recommendations of the Attorney General and it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet to the said Guidelines submitted by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms.

description: Amendments to the Civil Procedure Code (Chapter 101) (Pre-Trial 	Conference)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2021‑09‑27 to amend the Civil Procedure Code, enabling to make remedies for the issues and challenges that have arisen after implementing new provisions on pre-trial proceedings which were introduced by the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No.8 of 2017 and to expedite legal proceedings and reduce the time consumed in adjudication. Accordingly, relevant Bill has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Consolidated strategic communication programme for the promotion of 	national aspirations and international image of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of implementing a strategic communication programme to upgrade the international image of Sri Lanka and to manage a correct foreign policy in a balanced manner by strengthening international relations enabling to face global and regional challenges. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media and the Minister of Foreign Affairs to implement a  communication programme for the promotion of national aspirations and the international image of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a 33kV Double Circuit Zebra Tower Line from 	Kerawalapitiya Grid Substation to Nugape Junction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2022‑12‑19 to authorize the Minister in charge of the subject of Environment to amend the Gazette Notification No.1466/26 dated 2006‑10‑13 presently in force and issue a new Gazette Notification to enable to declare the Construction of a 33kv Double Circuit Zebra Tower Line to Nugape Junction from Kerawalapitiya Grid Substation in the periphery of Mudiyanse Ela of Muturajawela Environment Conservation Area, as a permissible activity. The Central Environmental Authority has informed the Ceylon Electricity Board that required permission could be granted to construct the said  33kV Double Circuit Zebra Tower Line along the boarder of the Muturajawela Environment Conservation Area instead of constructing the same in the periphery of Mudiyanse Ela. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to authorize the Minister in charge of the subject of Environment to issue a New Gazette Notification amending the Gazette Notification No.1466/26 dated 2006‑10‑13, declaring that construction of a 33kV Double Circuit Zebra Tower Line is a permissible task, enabling to construct the said power line along the proposed alternative route, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka and Hambantota Oil Refinery (Pvt) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-14
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2019‑09‑17 to enter into an Agreement  between the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka and Hambantota Oil Refinery (Pvt) Ltd., in order to set up a petroleum refinery at Hambantota with a 420,000 barrels capacity per day, exclusively for the export market. A land in extent of 1,200 acres has also been allocated on 50 years long term lease basis for implementing that project. However, the project proponent has not obtained the said land on lease basis and the project has also not yet been implemented. Although the project proponent has been informed several instances in writing regarding the implementation of the project, no response has been made in that regard. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to terminate the said Agreement, since the project proponent has not acted as per the provisions of the Agreement entered into by the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of water from the Samanalawewa Reservoir for cultivation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Minister of Power and Energy brought to the notice of the Cabinet on the alternative measures that could be taken pertaining to the proposal for the release of water from the Samanawewa Reservoir due to the lack of sufficient water for  cultivations of farmers engaged in farming under the Udawalawa Reservoir.  After an extended discussion on the said alternatives, the Cabinet granted approval to release the maximum possible quantity of water remaining in the Samanalawewa Reservoir for farming and to purchase the necessary electricity from the private sector as a solution to the issues arising with regard to electricity generation due to the above action.

description: Amendments to the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958 to guarantee the rate of interest on the contributions of the members of the Employees' Provident Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the necessity to ensure the retirement payments and benefits of the members of the Employees' Provident Fund without causing an impact on the same through the optimization of the Treasury Bonds held by the said Fund under the Domestic Debt Optimization Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to take necessary action to amend the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958 so as to guarantee the minimum annual rate of interest on contributions as 9% for the next period of time of four years from 2023 to 2026, taking into consideration the percentages of annual interest benefit paid to the members of the Employees' Provident Fund within the recent period of five years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Achievements in managing the Economic crisis and Way forward
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-07
decision_details_body: - The information presented by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, regarding the issues faced by the country when the current Hon. President was appointed as the Prime Minister and the Minister of Finance in May 2022 and after assuming duties of the Presidency on 2022‑07‑20, the actions taken so far together with the new Cabinet pertaining to the areas such as fiscal policy, monetary policy, energy sector, external sector, debt	restructuring and foreign financing in order to create the economic stability in the country by solving the said issues, was considered by the Cabinet.  Also, the Cabinet granted it's concurrence on the Reform measures that are expected to carry out in the future in order to create economic growth by restoring the economy.

description: Amendment to the Control of Pesticides Act, No.33 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-07
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of amending the Control of Pesticides Act, No.33 of 1980 in consistent with the regulatory priorities in the global pesticide industry and the approaches that support the investigations against growing illegal activities. Accordingly, The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill consisting of provisions including the recovery of public funds spent on eco‑friendly disposal of illegal pesticides from the offenders and the strengthening of punishment and activities related to suppression of repeated illegal acts by offenders and other relevant provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-07
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑03‑27 to amend section 6(3)(e) of the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010, enabling more number of service providers to take part in providing aeronautical services. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present it in the Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Act to regulate Container Depot Operators
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Licensing of Shipping Agents, Freight Forwarders, Non‑Vessel Operating Common Carriers, and Container Depot Operators Act, No.10 of 1972 has been amended several times and as per the provisions of the said Act, Container Depot Operators are to be regulated considering as a “Service Provider”. It has been observed that pursuing action in accordance with the aforesaid manner adversely affects on the development of Container Depot Operators on modern‑day trade, shipping, and logistics requirements and their infrastructure facilities. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to introduce a new Act with provisions for the regulation and control of business carried on by container depot operators, determination of rates and charges, imposition and collection of rates and charges and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision  of  a  government  owned  land  in  the  Hambantota  district  for brackish water prawn farming, on long term lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-07
decision_details_body: - A production of 14,414 Metric Tons have been obtained in the year 2021 through brackish water prawn farming which is a main commercial aquaculture farming in Sri Lanka and targets have been set up to increase the productions up to 50,000 Metric Tons and earn Rs.65,500 million of foreign exchange by the year 2025. However, lack of lands which could be utilized for aquaculture farming in this country remains as a challenge to expand the commercial aquaculture farming any further. In order to face this challenge, the National Aquaculture Development Authority has taken several measures such as introduction of modern technology to achieve a high productivity within a limited space. Accordingly, a Government owned land in extent of 218 acres and 30 perches in the Ambalantota Divisional Secretariat Division of the Hambantota district has been identified as suitable for farming Litopenaeus Vannamei which a farming cycle could be completed in a short period of time. Therefore, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries and the Minister of Tourism and Lands to lease out 109 acres and 15 perches each to W. S. R. Love & K. M. N. Aqua Services (Pvt) Ltd., and Rainbow Foods (Pvt) Ltd., the two companies which have been selected by following the Government Procurement process, based on the valuation of the Government Valuer, for a period of 30 years on long term lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National  Policy  on  Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of  Terrorism (AMI/CFT) of Sri Laka  and  the Action  Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Financial Intelligence Unit which has been established under the provisions of the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, No.6 of 2006, functions as a Department of the Central bank of Sri Lanka and it executes the provisions for the prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing and other unlawful activities defined in the Act. The Financial Actions Task Force, the inter‑governmental body which sets international standards to prevent Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, has introduced 40 recommendations to be implemented by all the countries. As such, the Asia Pacific Group on Money Laundering, the regional institute of the Financial Actions Task Force evaluates whether Sri Lanka functions in compliance with the recommendations of the said Task Force. The 3rd Mutual Evaluation on Sri Lanka by the said Group is due to be commenced from March 2025. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to implement the National Policy on Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism of Sri Laka for 2023‑2028 in order to fully assure the situation of Sri Lanka and to implement the Action Plans including the functions to be performed by each institution as remedies for the weaknesses identified in the prevention of Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Aswesuma Social Welfare Benefit Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-31
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the following arrangements presented by the Hon. President pertaining to the expeditious payment of benefits under the Aswesuma Social Welfare Benefit Programme:

    • Making payments for 1,588,835 beneficiaries who do not have appeals or objections pending against them, out of 1,792,265 beneficiaries selected by the Welfare Benefit Board for the Aswesuma Programme.
      
    • Making payments for 84,374 selected beneficiaries but have appealed for inclusion in a higher category, under their present category until a final decision is taken having completed the appeal review process.

    • Making entitled payments to 119,056 against whom objections have been filed, out of the selected beneficiaries, until the review process conducted with regard to the said objections is concluded.

    • Making payments for 393,094 Samurdhi beneficiaries who have applied for benefits through this programme but have not been selected, under the Samurdhi Programme until the review process for appeals and objections under the Aswesuma Programme is fully completed.

    • Making payments continuously for beneficiaries receiving Kidney Disease Support and Disability Support at present, through the Divisional Secretariats and paying Elders' Support through Post Offices.

    • Making relevant payments further for 11,660 persons who are suffering from kidney diseases, disabled or elderly,  in Care Homes or places of religious worship.

description: Obtaining Services for Aircraft of SriLankan Airlines at the Cochin International Airport (COK), India and the Jakarta International Airport (CGK), Indonesia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-31
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited by Srilankan Airlines Limited to select service suppliers for passenger and ramp and cargo handling services at the Cochin International Airport, India and the Jakartha International Airport, Indonesia. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the service supply contract of the  the Cochin International Airport, India, to AI Airport Services Limited and that of the Jakarta International Airport, Indonesia, to PT. Gapura Angkasa, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Standing Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the National Authority on Tobacco and Alcohol Act, No. 27 of 2006
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Health to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the the National Authority on Tobacco and Alcohol Act, No. 27 of 2006, so as to appoint Medical Officer of Health and Additional Medical Officer of Health as Authorized Officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a project to prevent the damage caused to the people 	who are frequently affected by the floods in the Gin River
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-31
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the need of implementing a project enabling to provide a permanent solution to prevent the damage caused to the people who are frequently affected by the floods in the Gin River. The proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with MCC- Sinohydro Consortium to carry out a feasibility study for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regularization and making efficiency of the role of the Inquirer-into-Sudden Deaths
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-31
decision_details_body: - The General public have been facing inconveniences in obtaining the services of Inquirer-into-Sudden Deaths owing to the absence of exact identification of relevant Inquirer-into-Sudden Deaths Divisions since such appointments are made on the Koralaya basis, municipal area basis and hospital basis. Prevalence of large number of vacancies in certain districts due to not granting Inquirer-into-Sudden Deaths appointments for a long period of time also has caused inconveniences to the General Public. With a view to settling such issues and providing a more efficient and regularized service to the General Public, the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has prepared a Standing Procedure Code clearly stating the provisions including the qualifications for appointment of Inquirer-into-Sudden Deaths, their responsibilities and role. The future programme planned by the Ministry relating to the attachment of all Inquirers-into-sudden Deaths already appointed to Divisional Secretariat Divisions and identified hospitals, appointment of bi-lingual Inquirers-into-Sudden Deaths for bi-lingual Divisional Secretariat Divisions and making fresh recruitments to fill up the remaining vacancies in terms of the provisions of the said Code, was forwarded to the Cabinet by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Cabinet decided to grant the concurrence for the same.

description: Submission of the Order issued under the provisions of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No.40 of 1979, for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-24
decision_details_body: - An order has been issued under the provisions of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act No. 40 of 1979 to increase the CESS duty levied on the importation of clinker, which is an intermediate material required for cement manufacturing, and fully finished and ready for sale cement, anticipating to increase the revenue generated by importing cement and allied products, while facilitating local manufacturers. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to present the said Order which has been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2336/71 dated 16 June 2023, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Australia for Cooperation in Sport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-24
decision_details_body: - The validity period of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed between Sri Lanka and Australia for a period of three years to develop cooperation in sports, has ended on 15 February 2020. It has been proposed to sign a new memorandum of understanding so that the said Memorandum of Understanding could be further extended for a period of three years aiming to identify the fields of sports in which outstanding talents can be shown between the two countries and exchange information and programmes between sportspersons and sports officials engaged in those fields as well as to strengthen the bilateral corporation in the field of sports based on mutual benefits. Accordingly, the two parties have reached to a consensus on the draft of the MoU prepared accordingly and the clearance of the Attorney General has also been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a License Agreement between the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation	and the National Radio and Television Administration of the People's Republic	of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-24
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a License Agreement between the National Radio and Television Administration of the People's Republic of China and the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation in order to exchange of television programmes, with the aim of strengthening the mutual understanding, friendship and cooperation between the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to sign the License Agreement prepared for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructuring of the Department of Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-24
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that it is essential to restructure the Department of Sri Lanka Railways which is classified as a Grade A department of the Government, providing both the  passenger and freight services, in order to reduce the conflicts that have arisen as of now with related to the administrative, financial and operational functions of the said Department and to maintain the provision of services at the optimal level and for that, the concurrence of all the parties related to the Department has been received. Accordingly, taking into account a proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways, the approval was granted by the Cabinet to appoint a committee consisting of experts on relevant subject to submit suitable proposals regarding the restructuring of the department under a more suitable model.

description: Financial Assistance from the World Bank for implementation of the Social	Protection Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-24
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023.05.08, to negotiate with the World Bank to secure funds for the implementation of a project that will provide better targeted income support and livelihood opportunities to the poor and vulnerable and strengthen the social protection system. In the negotiations held accordingly, the World Bank has agreed to provide US$ 200 million funds under three (03) components as US$ 185 million to support the new welfare benefit payment scheme 'Aswesuma', US$ 07 million to support the implementation of a pilot project to economically empower the selected beneficiaries and US$ 08 million to manage the overall project and strengthen the social protection system.  The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into the relevant Agreement with the International Development Association of the World Bank Group in order to obtain the relevant loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Fifth Round of Negotiations on the proposed Sri Lanka-Thailand Free	Trade	Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-24
decision_details_body: - The Fifth Round of Negotiations on the proposed Sri Lanka -Thailand Free Trade Agreement has been held from 2023.06.26 to 2023.06.28 in Colombo. During this Round, Negotiations on Chapters namely Customs Cooporation and Trade Facilitation, Economic Cooporation and Sanitary and Phytosanitary measures have been concluded. The information relating to the progress of the Fifth Round of Negotiations on Sri Lanka -Thailand Free Trade Agreement submitted by the Hon. President stating that it is expected to conclude the relevant negotiations by February, 2024 adhering to the Action Plan of the proposed Agreement and sign the Agreement by March, 2024, was considered by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑06‑28 has granted approval to introduce relevant amendments to the Inland Revenue Act No. 24 of 2017 to revise the income tax rate applicable on the income earned from investment made in Treasury Bonds by the Employees Trust Fund, Employees Provident Fund (EPF), Pension Fund or Gratuity Fund and similar Funds in order to facilitate the Domestic Debt Optimizing process.  The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Standard Operating Procedure for granting Diplomatic Clearance for Foreign Seaborne Vessels arriving in Sri Lanka and Foreign Military or State Aircrafts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - Due to the geostrategic location of Sri Lanka in the Indian Ocean, foreign seaborne vessels and foreign military or state aircrafts frequently visit Sri Lanka. Further, States and competent International Organizations are interested in carrying out Marine Scientific Research in the Exclusive Economic Zone and the Continental Shelf of Sri Lanka. In this context, it has been found necessary to prepare a Standard Operating Procedure so as to grant diplomatic clearance for such activities. Accordingly, the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs has submitted the Standard Operating Procedure prepared in consultation with all parties to the Cabinet and it was decided to grant approval for the same.

description: Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resource Development Scholarship Programme - 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to grant Yen 284 million (approximately Rs. 611 million) for the second batch of the 4th Framework of the Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme implemented under the Japanese Grant Aid. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to sign the Exchange Notes with the Government of Japan and enter into an Agreement with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to obtain the said Grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Passenger and Ramp Handling Services for SriLankana Airlines at the Chennai International Airport (MAA), India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - The current Standard Ground Handling Agreement for passenger and ramp handling services at the Chennai International Airport is due to expire on 2023‑10‑31. Bids have been invited following the Limited International Bidding Procedure to obtain the said services. Three bids have been received for the same and accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the relevant contract to Bird Airport Services (Chennai) Pvt. Ltd. for a period of 03 years based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for supplying of Aviation Fuel for SriLankan Airlines at Kathmandu Air Port, Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - The current contract to supply fuel to SriLankan Airlines aircraft at Kathmandu Airport is due to expire on 2023.08.31. Bids have been invited under the Limited International Procurement method for the selection of new aircraft fuel suppliers and only one bid has been received. Accordingly, the  proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the relevant contract to Associated Energy Group LLC, the only substantially responsive bidder, for a period of 02 years, based on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka to be a founding member of the Global Biofuels Alliance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - It has been announced at the India Energy Week held in February 2023 that steps will be taken to form a Global Biofuel Alliance during India's G20 presidency. Under the proposed alliance, it is expected to corporate the countries such as  Brazil, India and the United States which are leading biofuel producers and consumers, with other interested countries and encourage the sustainable usage of biofuels in the energy sector especially in transportation. Also, the proposed Alliance will pay their attention on developing and strengthening the market by facilitating the global biofuels trade, sharing the best practices towards the development of optimal policies and providing technical support for worldwide national biofuel practices. India seeks the endorsement of all the nations to join the said new Alliance and has invited Sri Lanka to sign the Foundational Document to become a founding member of the Alliance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy for Sri Lanka to be a founding member of the Global Biofuels Alliance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for strengthening Buddhist relations between Sri Lanka and India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding has been entered into between Sri Lanka and India on 2022-03-28 to implement the projects under a grant of US$ 15 million provided by the Government of India in order to strengthen the Buddhist relations between the two countries. Under the said Memorandum of Understanding, both parties have agreed to allocate US$ 10 million to provide solar power facilities for Buddhist temples and pirivenas. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to sign a fresh Memorandum of Understanding by making the relevant amendments to the Memorandum of Understanding already entered, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promoting Circular Economy in the Food Sector (PCEFS) Project, proposed to be financed under the European Union Grant Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - A grant of Euro 60 million  has been allocated for the period of 2021-2024 by the "Multi- Annual Indicative Programme 2021-2027 for Sri Lanka" which has been published under the European Union's country strategy for Sri Lanka. It has been proposed to implement a project called "Promoting Circular Economy in the Food Sector" using Euro 15 million from that grant. Promoting the circular economy of the food sector by increasing resilience to food crises and climate change has been identified as the primary objective of the proposed project. The project will support the adoption of efficient food distribution channels/mechanisms, to take action to improve food security for vulnerable people by minimizing food wastage, and to convert food waste into farming inputs such as organic fertilizer and animal feed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into a Grant Agreement with the European Union for the implementation of the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Prison Administration Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - The Prison system of Sri Lanka is governed under the Prison Ordinance No.16 of 1877 and it has been observed that the provisions included in the said Ordinance are not sufficient to the present day requirements. Further, certain provisions in the said Ordinance are inconsistent with International legal obligations and standards to which Sri Lanka is bound.  Therefore, an initial draft has been prepared by the Prison Law Reform Committee appointed by the then Minister of Justice upon the necessity of introducing a new Prison Administration Act. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reform to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill, based on the said initial draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the Concession on Embarkation Levy for Jaffna International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Meeting held on 2022‑12‑19 to charge only 50% of the embarkation levy to be paid by the International aviation companies at the Jaffna International Airport, for a period of 06 months, in order to promote the use of Jaffna International Airport. The said concessionary period has been expired by at 2023‑07‑11. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to extend the period of charging only 50% of the embarkation levy, by another 06 months so that the price of air tickets can be determined at an affordable price for the passengers using that airport, was approved by the Cabinet .

description: Revision of water and sewerage tariffs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-17
decision_details_body: - Financial viability and sustainability of the National Water Supply & Drainage Board have to be ensured, enabling to achieve the objectives of expanding the access to safe water and sanitation, improve service quality and implement sustainable water resource management practices. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply & Estate Infrastructure Development, Cabinet decided to grant approval to revise the water and sewerage tariffs, causing a minimum impact to the social security base provided to low income earning categories in relation to the education, religious and public water supply.

description: Selection of Transaction Advisors for Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Ltd., Canwill Holdings (Pvt)Ltd.(Hyatt), Hotel Developers Lanka Ltd., (Hilton) and Litro Gas Lanka Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2023‑03-13 to restructure the above mentioned companies. Accordingly, Expressions of Interest and Requests for proposal have been called for selecting Transaction Advisors for the said purpose by following the international competitive procurement procedure. Transaction Advisors for the above 4 companies have been selected by following the quality and cost based selection procedures from among the proposals shortlisted by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into relevant agreements with the following selected Transaction Advisiors, was approved by the Cabinet

	(i)	Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Ltd.- Alvarez and Marsal
	(ii) 	Canwill Holdings (Pvt) Ltd - Deloitte India
	(iii) 	Hotel Developers (Lanka) Ltd - Colliers Singapore
	(iv)	Litro Gas Lanka Ltd - Deloitte India

description: Provision of Welfare Benefit Payments for Elderly Beneficiaries,  Chronic Kidney Patients with unknown etiology (CKDu) and Differently-Abled Persons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Lists with about two million names identified for the implementation of the Aswesuma Welfare Benefit Payment Scheme have now been published at the Divisional Secretariat and Grama Niladhari Divisional levels for submitting appeals and objections. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies for making welfare benefit payments for the 3 social groups of Elderly Beneficiaries, Chronic Kidney Patients with unknown etiology (CKDu) and Differently-Abled Persons, stated in the Gazette Notification which has already been published, until such persons who have applied for obtaining welfare benefits are determined based on the most appropriate criteria and guidelines for obtaining such benefits under the said Programme.

description: Preparation of a Master Plan for development of the Hambantota District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Although, approval of the cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2018‑06‑26 to assign the task of obtaining consultancy services for the preparation of a Greater Hambantota Regional Structure Plan and a Detailed Master Plan for Key Growth Centres to Surbana Jurong (Private) Company, action have not yet been taken as per the said decision. The Government has decided to give priority to the development of the Hambantota district, and it has been identified that it would be more appropriate to assign the task of preparing a master plan for the development of Hambantota district to Surbana Jurong (Private) Company itself, which has been entrusted with the responsibility of preparing master plans for the development of the Colombo city and the Western Province, and the development of the Eastern Province Strategic Tourism Zone. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to assign the said task to  to Surbana Jurong (Private) Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enrollment of the 07th intake under the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meting held on 2023‑04‑24 to enroll the 07th intake under the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme, to follow degree courses in Non-State universities. The Bank of Ceylon and the Peoples' Bank have expressed their concurrence to implement this loan scheme with a minimum interest rate of 13% for the entire loan duration. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme for the students who have fulfilled requisite qualifications from among the students selected to follow degree courses upon the GCE(A/L) results in the years of 2019, 2020 and 2021, under the 07th intake, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mid-Year Fiscal Position Report
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - In terms of section 10 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.3 of 2003, the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance is required to release the Report of Mid-Year Fiscal Position to the general public by the end of June of each year and thereafter to table the same in Parliament. Accordingly, the Mid-Year Fiscal Position Report up to 2023‑06‑30 has been published on the website of the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to table the said Report in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill to amend the approved Borrowing Limit for the Financial Year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meting held on 2023‑06‑28 to amend the approved borrowing limit for the financial year 2023. Accordingly, a Bill has been drafted by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Appropriation Act, No.43 of 2022 and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette, and thereafter present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Order under subsection (2) of Section 29A of the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Section 29A(2) of the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978 indicates the provisions that the monetary value of all actions specified in the Seventh Schedule over which the Small Claims Court will have exclusive original civil jurisdiction, shall be designated by the Minister in-charge of the subject of Justice from time to time. The Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has published an Order in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2328/16 dated 2023.04.21, which states that the monetary value up to Rs. 1.5 million excluding the interest, which has been fixed to the said courts, shall be Rupees two million or not exceeding Rupees two million, excluding the interest. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to submit the said Order in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act No. 51 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - The Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023.01.02 to amend the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act No. 51 of 1979. Accordingly, the clearance of the  Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman.
